description: Dark cocoa, black pepper, and earthy oak shape the Blackfin's Parlay, a medium-to-full bodied smoke that opens with bold intensity before settling into a steady rhythm of spice, wood, and subtle sweetness. It's structured and dynamic, carrying the kind of balanced aggression that ADVentura's storylines are known for.The cigar is produced at Tabacalera Mina del Rey, the factory owned by ADV & McKay. In the ongoing ADVentura narrative, Blackfin's Parlay represents a “peace” or truce between the Pirate factions of Barbarroja's Invasion and Blue Eyed Jack's Revenge, continuing the brand's storytelling approach, though this time, the box skips the usual audio gimmick.

The ADVentura Blue Eyed Jack's Revenge Maduro High Tide opens with deeper, darker tones than the original, leaning harder into dark cocoa, earth, and leather with a more concentrated natural sweetness. The spice is more pronounced early, and the overall profile feels denser and more structured, with a slower, more deliberate burn and a fuller presence on the palate.The ADVentura Blue Eyed Jack's Revenge Maduro sits in a slightly more aggressive lane than the original. It shares the same core DNA of cocoa, earth, and Maduro sweetness; however, it packs quite the punch. High Tide feels like a focused, amplified take on that foundation. Distilling everything that made the original line a success into a super potent maduro, truly emblematic of what ADVentura has become.

A medium-strength smoke with a deep creamy profile highlighted with nutty and floral notes create an irresistibly sweet smoking indulgence. Its reddish, oily Mexican San Andres wrapper sheaths a Dominican Olor binder and a Dominican filler. The tobaccos for this delightful blend are aged for five years before they are rolled. Afterwards, the cigars are allowed to marinate for six months in climate controlled aging rooms before being boxed and shipped. This meticulous aging process lets the cigar's flavors marry and enhance the smoking experience. The ADVentura Blue Eyed Jacks Revenge cigars are handmade in the Dominican Republic. The cigars are tucked in a talking box that delivers a special message to whomever buys it.

A mild to medium-strength cigar with a smooth creamy and toasted bread profile accompanied by an irresistible sweetness and touches of spice and pepper. It features a warm tan Ecuadorian wrapper placed over a Dominican binder and Nicaraguan and Dominican filler leaves. Handmade in the Dominican Republic.

This medium bodied Nicaraguan puro sports a Jalapa wrapper known for its flavorful interplay between spice and sweetness. The wrapper covers a Criollo binder and a Corojo and Criollo '98 filler. This unique blend creates a notable smoking experience that is indicative of the exceptional tobacco that comes from this Central American country. The Aganorsa Leaf Rare Leaf Reserve Titan Corojo is hand crafted in Nicaragua, and it is sold at an attainable price that makes it a rare find in the world of premium cigars.

The Aging Room Bin No. 2 C Major is a medium-strength toro that is chiefly composed of tobacco grown in the rich soils of Omepete, a volcanic island in Nicaragua. Tobacco grown in Omepete is known for being sweet and earthy. It is also grown in small batches, so it is considered rare. The Aging Room Bin No. 2 is a Nicaraguan puro from filler to binder, and it is hand-crafted at the famed Plasencia Cigar factory in Nicaragua.

Cream, cedar, and toasted nuts form the foundation of the Aging Room Blue Amber, accented by a gentle sweetness and refined baking spice. Medium-bodied, the profile is composed, elegant, and complex.Created to commemorate the 15th anniversary of Aging Room, Blue Amber reflects the brand's dedication to balance, aging, and good tobacco. Blended under the direction of Rafael Nodal, using various prized tobaccos, including a Nicaraguan wrapper from AJ Fernandez.

This mild-strength Churchill provides a rich creamy indulgence with notes of sweetness and roasted nuts. Its Ecuadorian Connecticut Shade wrapper cloaks a binder and filler made of Dominican tobacco. The Aging Room Quattro Connecticut Concerto is hand crafted in the Dominican Republic.

This potent Churchill delivers savory notes of spice, cedar and coffee. Its Dominican binder and filler are cloaked by a rustic, dark-tan Sumatra wrapper. Made of carefully aged leaves, the Aging Room Quattro Original Concerto is handmade in the Dominican Republic.

The Aging Room Quattro F55M Concerto is a rich, full-bodied Dominican churchill which takes the hugely successful Quattro F55 and replaces the Sumatra wrapper with a gorgeous, leathery Mexican San Andres wrapper. The result is a delicious cornucopia of notes including cocoa, cedar, and earth, with a smooth yet spicy finish that will satisfy your palate from first puff to last.

This full-bodied yet balanced Churchill offers rich notes of cedar, chocolate, and earth. It is a Nicaraguan puro that features an oily dark chocolatey maduro wrapper. The Aging Room Quattro Nicaragua Concerto is expertly hand crafted in Nicaragua at AJ Fernandez's Tabacalera Fernandez factory.

This potent toro delivers savory notes of spice, cedar and coffee. Its Dominican binder and filler are cloaked by a rustic, dark-tan Sumatra wrapper. Made of carefully aged leaves, the Aging Room Quattro Original Vibrato is handmade in the Dominican Republic.

A medium-strength cigar that offers an arrangement of savory spicy, earthy, and coffee notes with touches of sweetness. This 100% Nicaraguan puro sports a dark chocolatey maduro wrapper. The cigars are handmade at AJ  Fernandez's factory in Nicaragua, and uses tobacco grown exclusively on farms owned by Fernandez. Brand owner Rafael Nodal's passion for music inspired him to create the Aging Room Quattro Sonata.

A medium-bodied robusto with notes of earth, black pepper, sweetness, oak and a delicious chocolatey aroma. A red-hued Cuban-seed hybrid wrapper covers this Nicaraguan puro's binder and filler. The rare Pelo de Oro tobacco is included in the filler, which adds to the cigar's distinct flavor profile. The blend for the collection was developed by Rafael Nodal and AJ Fernandez, two gifted and globally-recognized cigar crafters. The Aging Room Rare Collection Festivo is handmade in Nicaragua.

The Aladino Declaration is a special, limited release from JRE Tobacco Co. created to commemorate the 250th anniversary of the signing of the Declaration of Independence in 2026. Made entirely with tobacco grown by the Eiroa family, the blend remains undisclosed but continues the company's tradition of producing Honduran puros at its factory in Las Lomas, Jamastran.Each box contains 13 cigars as a tribute to the 13 original American colonies. The packaging also reflects this theme. The exterior displays the historic 13-colony flag, and the inside of the lid features the modern American flag along with the famous passage from the Declaration of Independence, honoring life, liberty, and the pursuit of happiness. Produced in limited quantities, the Aladino Declaration serves as both a collectible release and a tribute to the spirit of American independence and freedom.

A smooth, mild cigar with pleasing notes of grass, spice, sweetness, cedar, and tobacco. The cigar's alluring candela wrapper covers a binder and filler made of the Eiroa family's own Corojo tobaccos. The Aladino Candela is handmade in Honduras at the JRE Tobacco Company factory, which is owned and operated by the father and son team of Julio and Justo Eiroa.

Handcrafted by the JRE Tobacco Company in Jamastran Valley, Honduras, the Aladino Churchill is a medium-bodied cigar that brings back the Golden Era of Cuban cigar making. The Aladino is a Honduran puro that is skillfully made from the Corojo leave from filler to wrapper, which is grown by the world-famous Eiroa Tobacco Farm. The Aladino offers an interesting flavor profile that consists of cedar, citrus, and coffee.

This medium-bodied cigar delivers notes of cedar, tobacco, pepper and earth with a hint of floral. It is a Honduran puro with a Habano-seed maduro wrapper, a Corojo binder and a Habano-seed filler. Handmade in Honduras at the Fabrica de Puros Aladino factory, the Aladino Classic Toro is a traditional smoke with a Cubanesque look and feel.

A refined smoke, this medium-strength cigar delivers notes of cedar, almonds and spice. It is a Honduran puro made from 100% Corojo tobacco. This savory blend creates a smooth traditional smoke. The Aladino Corona is handmade in Honduras.

This short, stout vitola is a slow burner and offers a medium-bodied experience that showcases the unique character of Cameroon leaf cultivated in Honduras. This refined, complex smoke unfolds slowly, much like the thoughts of the smoker after lighting up. Initially released exclusively to retailers who attended JRE's farm experience in Honduras, this unique vitola and blend marks the launch of a new Aladino line scheduled to have fresh releases every year. You may also enjoy the Corojo and Maduro blends that are also a part of this inaugural release.

The Aladino Gorbusto Gori is a 4½ x 60 cigar crafted by JRE Tobacco Co., featuring an undisclosed Maduro wrapper. This short, stout vitola is a slow burner and offers a rich and flavorful full-bodied experience that showcases the excellence of JRE Tobaccos Honduran style. Bold, assertive, and unmistakably full in body, this cigar was blended to reflect the character of the smoker. Initially released exclusively to retailers who attended JRE's farm experience in Honduras, this unique vitola and blend marks the launch of a new Aladino line scheduled to have fresh releases every year. You may also enjoy the Chimp and Orang blends which are different, more nuanced expressions of the line.

The Aladino Gorbusto Orang is a 4½ x 60 Honduran puro featuring JRE Tobacco's signature Corojo wrapper. With its compact build and slow burn, we have a medium-bodied stick packed with classic Corojo character, it offers a rich and balanced smoke. Expressive and free-spirited, Orang is the energy in the room. His cigar is as unexpected as he is: creative in flavor, bold in character, and unlike anything else in the lineup. Initially released exclusively to retailers who attended JRE's farm experience in Honduras, this unique vitola and blend marks the launch of a new Aladino line, scheduled to have new releases every year.

A refined smoke, this medium-strength cigar delivers notes of cedar, almonds and spice. It is a Honduran puro made from 100% Corojo tobacco. This savory blend creates a smooth traditional smoke. The Aladino Gordo is handmade in Honduras.

This awesome Honduran puro was created to bring back the golden years of Cuban cigars, which took place in the late forties to the early sixties. Cedar, earth, and baking spice lead the profile of the Alec Bradley Thirty Years, supported by notes of toasted nuts and a subtle natural sweetness. Full-bodied and well-balanced, it delivers a layered smoking experience that reflects the brand's evolution over time.Created to commemorate three decades of Alec Bradley, this release is designed to reflect the brands history. The blend features a Honduran Trojes wrapper over a dual binder of Honduran Jamastran and Nicaraguan Jalapa, with fillers from Estelí and Jalapa in Nicaragua alongside Honduran tobaccos from Jamastran and Trojes. Crafted as a milestone cigar, Thirty Years showcases a mature, confident approach to blending that really comes through in the smoke.

The Alec Bradley Chunk Maduro delivers a naturally sweet blend that has a flavorful and balanced profile with notes of cocoa, roasted nuts, cedar, and a touch of black pepper. This short gordo contains long filler Dominican and Nicaraguan tobacco, a Honduran binder, and a Mexican San Andres wrapper. With an exceptional price and quality relationship, this medium to full bodied cigar offers a great ride for half the fare. The 2XL vitola is being made in limited quantities, while the rest of the line will become a standard offering.

The Alec Bradley Chunk Shade delivers smooth flavors of tea, hay, and bready toast in a mellow medium profile. These short, stout cigars feature a Honduran-grown Connecticut Shade wrapper, a U.S. Broadleaf binder, and a filler blend from three countries. With a large ring gauge, soft but flavorful profile, this cigar gives a lot more than it takes. Alec Bradleys Chunk line is a great pick when you want a lot without spending a lot.

Smooth and complex from the first draw, Do Not Disturb delivers a refined flavor profile of earth, hay, and cedar, with a subtle spice that gradually intensifies, making for a mellow yet evolving experience. Produced in the Dominican Republic at Tabacalera La Isla, this medium-bodied cigar features an Ecuadorian Connecticut-seed wrapper, a Dominican Criollo binder, and a well-balanced filler blend of Dominican and Mexican tobaccos. Alec Bradley crafted Do Not Disturb as an invitation to pause, unwind, and savor a moment of peace, perfect for quiet reflection or relaxed conversation.

This not so spooky medium bodied smoke offers a frightfully delightful smoking indulgence with its rich cocoa notes and touches of honey sweetness. Its alluring barber pole wrapper consists of a USA Connecticut Broadleaf entwined with an Ecuadorian Habano leaf. This eye-catching wrapper shrouds an Indonesian Besuki binder which is stuffed with Dominican Piloto leaves as well as leaves from Jalapa, Esteli, and Condega, which are three of Nicaragua's top tobacco growing regions. The cigars are handmade in Honduras. Pair it with a pumpkin spice beer. The beers warm spices and sweet malt profile will complement the cigars cocoa, and honey sweetness notes. For coffee lovers, pair the cigar with a mild pumpkin spice coffee or a black coffee with pumpkin spice syrup. Take a puff, let it out, and take a sip of the coffee and you note how the coffee enhances the smoking experience. This is a limited edition cigar. Only 1,500 collectible boxes of 24 cigars per box were made. Order yours today before this ghostly cigar vanishes into thin air.

An annual treat that offers a “fine and rare” medium-bodied smoking experience with its deep complexity of flavors that can only be obtained by carefully blending 10 different tobacco leaves to create a one-of-a-kind cigar. Since 2011, Alec Bradley has released a Fine and Rare cigar with a new blend. For this release, the blend consists of a Criollo 98 wrapper from Trojes, Honduras, a dual binder consisting of a Corojo 99 leaf from Trojes as well as a Criollo 98 leaf from Jamastran, Honduras. The filler is composed of Corojo 99 leaves from Jamastran and Trojes in Honduras and Esteli, Nicaragua, Criollo 98 leaves from Jamastran, Honduras and Esteli and Jalapa, Nicaragua, and Corojo 98 leaves from Trojes, Honduras. Whew! Incredibly, this specially arranged blend provides an intricate and satisfying smoke that must be tried to be believed. The Alec Bradley Fine and Rare A(11)-FYT is handmade in Honduras. This is a very limited-edition cigar. Only 1,500 boxes of 10 cigars per box were made. Order yours today!

Its time for Alec Bradleys annual treat that always offers a fine and rare medium-bodied smoking experience. Since 2011, Alec Bradley has released a new Fine and Rare cigar. Each one has been blended with 10 unique tobacco leaves to create a one-of-a-kind cigar with a different expression every year. This years release contains a beautiful Colorado wrapper from Trojes, Honduras, and features two binders, one from Trojes and one from Esteli, Nicaragua. For those counting, that leaves 7 remaining filler tobaccos from 4 different countries: Criollo (Dominican Republic)Jamastran (Honduras)Jamastran (Honduras)Jalapa (Nicaragua)Jalapa (Nicaragua)Esteli (Nicaragua)Mexican San Andrés This is a very limited-edition cigar. Only 1,500 boxes of 10 cigars per box were made. Order yours today!

This medium-bodied cigar's toasty and savory profile is highlighted by a palate pleasing berry sweetness. Its mouthwatering Honduran Criollo maduro wrapper cloaks a dual binder and filler made of Honduran and Nicaraguan leaves. The cigar uses 10 leaves in its blend, which is a difficult task, to create a memorable smoking indulgence. The BCN-143 cigar is part of Alec Bradley's Fine and Rare collections. The cigars in this line are handmade in Honduras by the Raices Cubanas factory's most experienced rollers. The Alec Bradley Fine and Rare BCN-143 was awarded the #21 spot in Cigar Aficionado's Top 25 Cigars of the Year in 2012 and received a 91 rating.

The Alec Bradley Fine and Rare HOF/506 2019 is a limited-edition, box-pressed toro that is expertly composed of 10 tobacco leaves. It is hand crafted by Raices Cubanas in Honduras. This iteration of the Fined and Rare line features a dark, mouthwatering Honduran Trojes wrapper that beautifully covers a double binder of tobacco leaves from Honduras and Nicaragua. Its core consists of seven long-filler tobaccos from Honduras and Nicaragua. This full-bodied beauty delivers a complexity of flavors that includes wood, earth, cream, and sweetness. The Alec Bradley Fine and Rare HOF/506 2019 was created in honor of Alec's father David who passed away in 2018. Only 2,500 boxes containing 10 cigars per box were produced, so get yours today before they're all gone.

Since 2011, Alec Bradley has proudly released the most ambitious and complicated blend in their arsenal once every year to the delight of cigar aficionados everywhere. This enticing project is known as Alec Bradley Fine and Rare, a hearty cornucopia of 10 different Nicaraguan and Honduran tobaccos which span a wide range of regions and aging. Few other cigars match the inevitable complexity offered by this limited-edition, medium-bodied smoke, so dont let it disappear before you get a chance to sample its exquisitely rich and unique flavor.

Alec Bradleys Fine & Rare Ta-25A is made of 10 tobacco leaves, and this special Blenders Box contains, in addition to the 10 Fine and Rare 7 * 54 cigars, 10 small cigars, each made of the 10 component tobaccos. Each rustic, component cigar is packaged inside a glass tube. Smoke each one to see the taste that each of the 10 component tobaccos add to the final Fine & Rare blend. The cigars are made in Honduras by Raices Cubanas. Only 250 boxes were made.

Sold in 20 count boxes, the Alec Bradley Its A Boy cigars make a wonderful gift for new parents. The box has a picture frame to include a photograph of the baby in the gift, and the inside lid allows to write the babys stats. A great keepsake.

The Alec Bradley Occidental Reserve Robusto is a wallet friendly cigar that's perfect for smoking while mowing the lawn, enjoying a BBQ or just lounging around. This mild-bodied stick is composed of a light-brown Ecuadorian Connecticut Shade wrapper and a Dominican Republic binder and filler. Once lit, it offers a smooth creamy smoking experience that will pair perfectly with your morning coffee. It is handmade by the Occidental Cigar Factory in the Dominican Republic.

This medium to full strength cigar's woody, spicy, chocolatey, fruity sweetness, cocoa notes and peppery finish give the cigar its rich complexity. This Honduran puro sports a smooth, dark chocolatey maduro wrapper. The cigars are handmade at Raices Cubanas factory in Honduras. The Alec Bradley TAA Exclusive LE Toro is exclusively available through members of the Tobacconists' Association of America (TAA). The TAA is a group of the top tobacconists in the nation. It consists of about 80 retailers and 40 manufacturers, which Neptune Cigars is proud to be a member of. Only 500 boxes of 10 cigars per box were made so place your order today.

Like its avian namesake, the Blackbird Cactus Wren is a short run cigar, which means it is hard to get. So be sure to order it by the box.

A medium strength cigar with delightful notes of sweetness, spice, pepper and chocolate. A Brazilian Colorado wrapper deftly covers an Indonesian binder and a Dominican Republic filler. Handmade in the Dominican Republic, the Blackbird Cuco Gran Toro is a great everyday smoke.

Only 600 boxes of 14 cigars per box were made so order yours now before this bird flies the coop.

Inspired by the vibrant songbird, its bold Brazilian Arapiraca wrapper helps create a balanced profile highlighted by notes of wood, cocoa, espresso, subtle spice, and natural sweetness.

A mild, budget-friendly smoke with a rich creaminess highlighted by peppery, coffee, and honey sweetness notes. An Ecuadorian Connecticut Shade wrapper surrounds a binder from the Dominican Republic, which contains, Dominican, Nicaraguan, and USA Pennsylvania short and long-filler leaves.   The Blackbird Nest Connecticut is an excellent companion to a morning smoke. Flavorful notes of spice, espresso, and chocolate add a rich complexity to this wallet-pleasing, medium-strength cigar. Expertly handmade in Nicaragua, each cigar is capped off with a stylish pigtail. The cigar is best paired with a märzen-style beer, which is very popular during Octoberfest. The Brick House Bricktoberfest 2023 is a limited-edition release cigar that celebrates Octoberfest. This is the 6th release of this popular and festive cigar. J.C. Newman invites you to get into the spirit of Octoberfest, by participating in the annual Bricktoberfest special promotion. From September 18th to October 31st, 2023, purchase 5 Brick House cigars, and receive a free Brick House Bricktoberfest 2023 Pilsner Stein.

Brick House Bricktoberfest 2025 continues J.C. Newman's annual fall promotion, first launched in 2017 to coincide with Oktoberfest. Produced at the PENSA factory in Estelí, this medium-strength release uses an Ecuadorian Habano wrapper over Nicaraguan binder and fillers. Packaged in boxes of 10, the series has become a seasonal showcase for Brick House's Nicaraguan craftsmanship and its role as one of J.C. Newman's cornerstone premium cigar brands.

The original Brick House cigars were Cuban puros, handmade with the finest Havana tobaccos. Third-generation cigar makers, Eric and Bobby Newman, have recreated this vintage cigar brand by blending specially aged Nicaraguan tobaccos with hearty Havana Subido wrapper leaves to match the rich, well balanced flavor of their grandfathers Brick House cigars. This flavorful Churchill was rated 91 by Cigar Aficionado.

Deep notes of cocoa, coffee, spice and earth combine to deliver a well-balanced smoke. Its smooth, reddish Ecuadorian Habano wrapper covers a binder and filler made of Nicaraguan leaves. Its aged tobaccos were carefully selected to re-create the flavor and aroma of the original Brick House cigars, which were made of Cuban tobacco. The Brick House Corona is handmade in Nicaragua.

Deep notes of cocoa, coffee, spice, and earth combine to deliver a well-balanced smoke. Its smooth, reddish Ecuadorian Habano wrapper covers a binder and filler made of Nicaraguan leaves. Its aged tobaccos were carefully selected to re-create the flavor and aroma of the original Brick House cigars, which were actually Cuban cigars. As far as the blend goes, these Brick House is On Fire TAAs are no different than your standard Brick House. It's what they do with the blend that makes it unique. This TAA exclusive version of Brick House has a shaggy foot, meaning that for the first inch or two, you taste none of the binder or wrapper and all of the filler. This makes for an incredibly unique experience when smoking a shaggy foot. You get to experience the fillers of the blend before hitting the binder and wrapper; in this way, the blend plays out in front of you like a film. If you're a fan of J.C. Newman or Brick House, or just want to try something new, this will definitely be an unforgettable cigar experience.

This cigar is named after the farm which produces the wrapper for this cigar, the Coyolar farm. This is a farm that Julio Eiroa had wanted to grow cigar wrappers on for some time, because of its great climate and quality of the soil. The Camacho Coyolar Puro is the first cigar produced with the wrapper from the Coyolar farm. It has a full bodied, yet smooth, flavor. This Robusto is the perfect size to introduce you to this brand. If you like the rest of the Camacho line, you should try this one.

This full-bodied cigar offers earthy, spicy, creamy, and cedar notes with hints of cacao. Its Ecuadorian Corojo wrapper drapes a Honduran binder a Nicaraguan, Honduran and Dominican filler. Handmade in Honduras, the Camacho Factory Unleashed Toro has a shaggy foot, which lets you enjoy the filler's flavors before it combines with the wrapper. This full-strength stick personifies the innovative spirit of the world-famous Camacho factory. This is a limited release cigar only 1,000 “crates” of 100 sticks per crate were made so order yours today.

The Camacho Hard Charger Toro is the latest release in the Brotherhood series, Camachos military-inspired line of cigars. The Hard Charger is expertly handmade in Danli, Honduras a region well-known for making premium cigars. A USA Broadleaf maduro wrapper surrounds the binder and filler, which is made of Honduras corojo tobacco to give the Hard Charger its medium bodied profile. The Hard Charger is a limited edition release, only 1,500 boxes of 20 cigars were made, so order yours double time.

This potent stick is an invigorating smoke with notes of pepper, spice and coffee. Its Ecuadorian maduro wrapper drapes a Nicaraguan binder and Honduran and Dominican Republic long-filler leaves. It has a creamy finish and a mesmerizing aroma that will help you break free from the commonplace. Handmade in Honduras, the Camacho Liberty Series 2021 Churchill marks the 19th annual release of this memorable stick that invites you to live loud, bold, and free. Each stick is carefully placed in a commemorative wooden box that symbolizes the American spirit of life, liberty and the pursuit of happiness (aka a great cigar). Only 1,500 collectible boxes of 20 cigars per box were made so be sure to order yours today.

Since its original introduction 16 years ago, the Camacho Liberty has become an extremely anticipated yearly release for collectors and aficionados everywhere. The Liberty 2005 Throwback shows the return of the popular 2005 Liberty blend, complete with the 11/18 Figurado vitola the brand has become known for. Made up of an oily Honduran Maduro wrapper on top of premium Honduran Corojo binder and filler, this bold and complex smoke will satisfy your palate with notes of earth, leather, cocoa and spice. Packaged in American flag themed coffins, this throwback is just a quick walk down Memory Lane, as the tobacco used is so rare only 1,500 boxes were produced. Dont miss your chance to reminisce.

The Camacho Liberty 2012 Throwback is a medium-strength perfecto that is handmade in the Dominican Republic at the Davidoff factory. A Honduran Corojo puro from filler to wrapper, the Camacho Liberty 2012 Throwback harkens back to the original blends that made Camacho cigars one of the most sought after sticks by cigar aficionados. The Camacho Liberty 2012 Throwback has a complexity of flavors that includes notes of cedar, chocolate, and black pepper.

This full-strength, cigar offers spicy, woodsy, earthy and sweetness notes. Its Ecuadorian Habano wrapper covers a Honduran binder and long-filler tobaccos from Honduras and the Dominican Republic. Like a pack of firecrackers on the Fourth of July this box-pressed stick will jolt your palate with its complexity of flavors. Handmade in Honduras, the Camacho Liberty 2020 Gordo BXP is the eighteenth installation of the Camacho Liberty Series that celebrates the birth of the United States of America. Only 2,550 boxes of 20-cigars per box were made, so declare your independence from the same old, same old and order yours today before they're all gone.

Cocoa, coffee, rich spice, nuttiness, and earthiness are the dominant notes of Camachos Limited Edition 2025. Wrapped in Mexican San Andrés Maduro with a Honduran binder and Honduran-Dominican fillers, it marks the first release in a new line of bold, yearly limited editions from Camacho.

This imposing giant sports a muscular, dark chocolatey Honduran Habano wrapper placed over a Nicaraguan Habano binder, and a filler composed of Honduran and Nicaraguan leaves. A full-bodied smoke, the Torque 60 will take you through some wicked twists and turns with its ultra-spicy profile. Handmade in Nicaragua, the CAO Torque marks the first time this iconic brand has crafted a cigar this size.

These beans are considered the best in the world. The CAO Flavours Bella Vanilla Corona is handmade in the Dominican Republic.

To preserve is tantalizing aroma and flavor each cigar is nested in an aluminum tube. Handmade in the Dominican Republic, the CAO Flavours Cherrybomb Tubos offers a short but flavorful smoking experience.

This flavor infused cigar has a white chocolate truffles and Irish cream profile with notes of hazelnut, cocoa, and vanilla. Its Cameroon wrapper covers a Dominican binder and filler. Handmade in the Dominican Republic, the CAO Flavours Eileen's Dream Corona will appeal to smokers looking for a short but flavorful smoke.

This medium-bodied smoke's syrupy sweetness is accented with lively notes of white pepper and a peppery retro-hale. The CAO FASA Noche is a great companion to a whisky or an after dinner espresso. Plus, it's wallet-friendly price makes it an excellent everyday smoke. The cigars are handmade in Nicaragua.

A mild to medium bodied premium long filler cigar with a creamy smoke texture, light natural sweetness, touch of spice, hay, and nuts. This is a lovely choice for a smoker seeking a cigar that balances a flavorful but mellow taste profile. Constructed out of an Ecuadorian Connecticut Shade grown wrapper, Cameroon binder, and fillers from the Dominican and Nicaragua that delivers a quality experience in a price bracket that doesnt have a lot of competition.

A potent smoke with an earthy and sweetness profile accompanied by spicy and fruity notes. Its Honduran maduro wrapper covers a Honduran binder and filler leaves from Italy, Nicaragua and Peru. The CAO Italia Ciao offers a hearty and flavorful smoking indulgence that pairs well with a single malt scotch. It was name Robb Report's Best of the Best in 2005. Handmade in Honduras.

Handmade in the Dominican Republic, the CAO Flavours Moontrance Corona offer a savory smoke that can be enjoyed any time of day.

This medium strength cigar delivers notes of nuts, vanilla, toast and pepper. It sports a Honduran Colorado wrapper, a Honduran binder and filler leaves from Nicaragua: Esteli, Jalapa and Condega. These are Nicaragua's top-tobacco producing regions. The CAO Nicaragua Granada is handmade in Nicaragua.

The CAO Surplus Shade bundle is a handmade cigar produced at STG Danlí with a focus on straightforward, reliable quality. It uses a Honduran Connecticut wrapper over an Ecuador Sumatra binder and Dominican Olor filler, a traditional combination chosen for balance and approachability. Designed as an affordable bundle, it highlights how classic long-filler construction can be delivered in a simple, no-frills format. It is also available in Maduro and Sweet versions, giving smokers additional options for a punchier profile or a touch of added flavor.

The CAO Surplus Sweet bundle is an easy smoking medium bodied handmade cigar designed to deliver approachable flavor at everyday value. It features an Ecuador Sumatra wrapper over a matching Sumatra binder with a core of Dominican Olor long-filler, known for its light spice and aromatic character. A sweetened cap subtly influences the smoke, adding a gentle layer of delight that complements the natural tobacco flavors. Rolled at STG Danlí, it reflects traditional handcraft presented in a simple, budget-friendly format. It is also available in Maduro and Shade versions, giving smokers additional options punchier and more mellow natural profiles.

The Casa 1910 Mexigars MX-1 is crafted entirely on Mexican soil, this 6 x 52 Toro is a celebration of the country's finest tobaccos, anchored by the legendary San Andrés leaf. Its medium-bodied profile delivers a dynamic flavor journey, showcasing the earthy complexity and spice that San Andrés is known for. A proud tribute to Mexico's deep-rooted cigar tradition, launched in 2024 as part of the Mexigars line—an homage to the bold spirit and rich soil of the nation. From seed to ash, the MX-1 is a love letter to Mexico's tobacco-growing heritage.

The Casa 1910 MexiGars MX-2, introduced in 2024, is a bold tribute to Mexico's storied tobacco tradition, crafted entirely in Mexico using 100% Mexican-grown tobaccos. Showcasing a Mexican Habano wrapper, a hearty Mexican Negro San Andrés binder, and a filler blend of Mexican Negro San Andrés and Habano Mexico Especial, this cigar embodies the depth and complexity for which Mexican tobacco is renowned. Created to deliver premium quality at an accessible price, the MX-2 invites both seasoned aficionados and curious newcomers to experience the rich legacy and craftsmanship of Mexico's cigar heritage.

The Casa Carrillo 2025 TAA Exclusive offers notable depth from its Connecticut Broadleaf wrapper, balanced by a smooth Dominican binder and rich fillers from Nicaragua and the U.S. Tasting notes of earth, cocoa, sweetness, and subtle spice accompany this potent stick. This limited-edition 6 x 54 box-pressed toro is produced at the Casa Carrillo factory in the Dominican Republic. With only 1,000 boxes of 10 cigars available, the release was only distributed to authorized TAA retailers. The result is an exclusive, full-bodied, and refined smoking experience suitable for any palate.

This potent stick offers notes of leather, nuts, black pepper, coffee and sweetness. Its tan Ecuadorian Habano wrapper cloaks a Nicaraguan binder and a Colombian, Nicaraguan and Dominican filler. It is Casa Cuevas first full-bodied, full-strength stick. It features a pigtail cap and a shaggy foot, which showcases the Cuevas' skills at crafting a cigar that is a feast for the eyes as it is for the palate. La Mandarria is Spanish for sledgehammer, and like its name, this stick will shatter all of your preconceptions of what a great cigar should be. The Casa Cuevas La Mandarria LE Toro is handmade in the Dominican Republic.

A medium bodied stick with notes of earth, cedar and nuts. Its Ecuadorian Habano wrapper covers a Nicaraguan binder and filler leaves from Colombia, Pennsylvania, Nicaragua and Dominican Republic. Handmade in the Dominican Republic at Tabacalera Las Lavas, the Casa Cuevas Limited Edition Habano Flaco offers a blissful smoking experience you won't want to miss.

Hand crafted in the Dominican Republic at Tabacalera Las Lavas, the Casa Cuevas Limited Edition Maduro Flaco offers a palate pleasing experience you must try.

Handmade at the Cueva's Tabacalera las Lavas, SRL factory in the Dominican Republic, this is one box worthy tribute cigar, so be sure to order more than one.

Handmade in the Dominican Republic, the Casa Cuevas Reserva Maduro Toro is part of the Cuevas signature line.

Handmade in the Dominican Republic at the Tabacalera Las Lavas factory, the Casa Cuevas Sangre Nueva Robusto offers a bold and savory smoking experience that appeals to contemporary as well as traditional aficionados.

A pleasant mild to medium-strength cigar with a deep creaminess and teasing notes of baker's spice, dark coffee, and a warm earthiness. Its smooth, golden Ecuadorian Connecticut Shade wrapper drapes a Nicaraguan binder and filler. Casa de Garcia Centenario Gold Label is a value-priced cigar that's perfect for a weekend BBQ or a morning smoke. The cigars are handmade in Nicaragua by Plasencia Cigars.

A potent and flavorful smoke that delivers notes of sweet spice, earth, and hints of coffee. A binder and filler made of Nicaraguan leaves supports the cigar's red-hued Ecuadorian Habano wrapper. The Casa de Garcia Centenario Red Label is a wallet-friendly cigar that appeals to the contemporary or traditional smoker who is looking for a great everyday smoke.

Handmade in the Dominican Republic, the Casa de Garcia Maduro Robusto sports a rich, dark Connecticut shade wrapper that is draped over a Connecticut Broadleaf binder and specially aged Dominican and Honduran long-filler tobaccos. A medium-strength cigar, the Casa de Garcia Maduro offers up a well-balanced combination of flavors that includes cocoa, chocolate, and cedar with a hint of spice.

A flavorful, full-strength cigar with creamy and spicy notes and hints of earth and coffee. Its smooth, light-tan Ecuadorian Connecticut Shade wrapper sheaths a Nicaraguan binder and filler. This contrasting blend creates an intense smoking experience that will delight the veteran as well as the novice smoker. The Casa Magna Connecticut Robusto is handmade at Quesada's Tabacos de Exportacion in the Dominican Republic.

Casa Magna D. Magnus II Optimus is an oval pressed Corona Gorda cigar that will delight your palate with earthy, toasty, leathery notes and hints of sweet cocoa. The cigar is finished with a pigtail cap and is made by Plasencia in partnership with Manolo Quesada.

A flavorful and potent cigar that offers up notes of chocolate, pepper, cedar, and nuts along with a long finish. This Nicaraguan puro sports a rustic, reddish maduro wrapper and it is stuffed with a premium Nicaraguan tobacco. The Casa Magna D. Magnus II Caligula is a long, thick box-pressed shaped cigar with a tapered head and foot. At first glance, the cigar looks round, but, when picked up, you soon see its true shape. This uniquely rolled cigar is indicative of the fine craftsmanship that has become a staple of Plasencia Cigars, which hand crafts the cigars for Quesada Cigars.

The Casa Magna Jalapa Claro Gran Toro was created by renowned master blenders Manuel Quesada and Nestor Plasencia, and is a medium-bodied Nicaraguan puro made at the Plasencia factory in Esteli. Delivers rich notes of spice, earth, and sweetness. Its oily, dark Ecuadorian maduro wrapper covers a Brazilian binder and filler leaves from the Dominican Republic, Brazil, and Nicaragua. The Davidoff Oro Blanco is a well-balanced premium cigar with a refined taste and aroma you will remember long after you have smoked it.

Only 4,000 boxes available.

Thereby, naturally infusing the essence and aroma into the final smoking experience.

Warm notes of nuts, caramel, and sweetness along with subtle touches of pepper and citrus will greet your palate from first to last puff as you enjoy this medium-bodied cigar. The Davidoff Year of the Horse 2026 was blended around a rare composition of proprietary hybrid seeds: an Ecuadorian hybrid wrapper, an Ecuadorian hybrid binder, and three Dominican hybrid fillers. This marks the first time Davidoff has created a blend made entirely from its own hybrid seed varieties, each developed through a years-long selection process. The release also carries a symbolic connection as Zino Davidoff himself was born in the Year of the Horse. This cigar was designed to reflect the zodiac sign's elegance, vitality, and expressive spirit. While the cigar has not yet debuted, Davidoff describes the profile as sweet and rich, with notes of milk chocolate, roasted hazelnut, and subtle spice. Like many Davidoff Chinese New Year editions, this is a collector-oriented release showcasing the brand's highest level of craftsmanship. Get yours while it's available!

The Eiroa Dark 30th marks three decades of Christian Eiroa's influence on the premium cigar industry, reimagining one of the brand's most celebrated blends for a new generation of smokers. Dark chocolate, espresso, earth, and black pepper are reported, with underlying notes of cedar, sweetness, and baking spice adding depth to the profile. Rich, bold, and full of character, the cigar builds on the foundation of the original Eiroa Dark while introducing new dimensions to the blend.Created to commemorate Eiroa's 30 years in the cigar business, the Eiroa Dark 30th moves beyond the original Honduran puro concept by incorporating tobacco from the company's Colombian farm, including Pinareño tobacco alongside the Corojo varieties that have become synonymous with the Eiroa name. While the final blend details have yet to be finalized, the project represents both a celebration of the past and a glimpse into the future of the Eiroa portfolio, blending innovation with the family's longstanding commitment to great tobacco.

The ECCJ was created to commemorate the 20th anniversary of Cigar Journal magazine (formerly known as European Cigar Cult Journal). This is a limited release cigar, only 2,000 boxes of 15 cigars per box were made, so order a box today, before theyll gone.

A medium-bodied cigar that will pamper your palate with rich notes of cedar, almonds, white pepper, and a creamy finish. It is an all-Nicaraguan cigar that sports a smooth, natural wrapper. A medium bodied smoke with chocolatey and earthy notes and a woody aroma. This Nicaraguan puro sports a rustic natural wrapper. Handmade in Nicaragua. A medium bodied cigar that delivers notes of sweetness, cocoa, cinnamon, and citrus. When first released and before being acquired by Illusione, its name created much debate as to whether or not it had Cuban tobacco.

A smooth, mild smoke that exudes a warm creaminess accompanied by notes of cocoa, sweetness, cedar, and nuts. This Nicaraguan puro sports a lush verdant Double Claro (aka Candela) wrapper. To celebrate a century of making great cigars, La Aurora created the La Aurora 100 Anos Robusto which earned the #2 spot in Cigar Aficionado's Top 25 Cigars of the Year in 2004. This special edition blend uses the same Dominican binder and filler; however, it substitutes a USA Connecticut Broadleaf wrapper for the original Corojo for a blend with more smoke texture and a louder taste. Another unique treat from the storied Dominican brand, La Aurora!

To commemorate their more than 100 years of creating premium cigars, La Aurora Cigars has released the La Aurora 115th Robusto an expertly crafted cigar that is handmade in the Dominican Republic. A medium-strength cigar, the 115th sports an alluring Ecuadorian wrapper that cloaks a Brazilian binder, which contains a specially blended filler made of tobaccos from Brazil, Nicaragua, and the Dominican Republic. A complex flavor profile with a strong woodsy base and notes of cinnamon, nuts, and citrus will treat your palate to an unforgettable smoking experience when you light up the La Aurora 115th. The La Aurora 115th Robusto is sold in boxes of 20 cigars per box.

A balanced, full-bodied cigar with a rich complexity that is marked by its woody, spicy, peppery notes underlined by a delicious sweetness and soothing notes of cocoa, coffee, and vanilla. This Dominican Republic puro boasts a Dominican Havana 92 wrapper draped over an Olor del Valle del Cibao binder and a filler of various tobaccos including Corojo, Olor del Valle del Cibao and Piloto Cubano del Valle del Cibao. The cigar's inviting wrapper was chosen for its distinct flavor profile and its ability to provide an even burn. The La Aurora 120th Anniversary cigar was created to celebrate this historied brand's 120th anniversary. The cigars are made at La Aurora's cigar factory using tobacco grown on La Aurora's owned and operated farms as well as tobacco from partner farms. The cigars are expertly handmade at the brand's factory in the Dominican Republic.

A medium-bodied smoke that delivers notes of cedar, spice, and leather with an underlying sweetness. The blend features a Cameroon wrapper over an Ecuadorian Sumatra binder and a Nicaraguan and Dominican filler. Handmade in the Dominican Republic, the La Aurora 1903 Cameroon is revamped version of the classic Aurora Cameroon, which was released in 2017.

This savory medium-bodied cigar offers peppery, earthy, and cedar notes. Its Corojo-seed Dominican wrapper covers an Ecuadorian binder and a Dominican and Nicaraguan filler. Handmade in the Dominican Republic, the La Aurora 1962 Corojo marks the year La Aurora Cigars first started crafting cigars with Corojo tobacco.

A flavorful, full-bodied cigar with an earthy profile and hints of pepper, nuts, coffee, and cream. its dark, oily Brazilian maduro wrapper covers a Nicaraguan binder and filler. Handmade in the Dominican Republic, the La Aurora 1985 Maduro is part of La Aurora's Time Capsule Series (which celebrates the year in which La Aurora first started working with a particular wrapper).

A mild to medium cigar with notes of cinnamon, sweetness, red fruits, cocoa, nuts, and a woody aroma. Its USA Connecticut Shade wrapper covers a Dominican binder and long-filler tobaccos. Handmade in the Dominican Republic, the La Aurora 1987 Connecticut marks the first time La Aurora Cigars started offering a Connecticut Shade wrapper in its blend.

A potent yet balanced cigar with a spicy and woody profile and hints of spice. Its Dominican wrapper covers a Cameroon binder and fillers made of Nicaraguan, USA Pennsylvania, and Dominican Andullo tobacco to create a truly Dominican smoking experience. Handmade in the Dominican Republic, the La Aurora Dominican DNA is one cigar you will want to enjoy after a hearty meal due to its strength.

This medium-bodied cigar offers a deep smoking experience with rich woody, nutty, spicy, and peppery notes highlighted by a delectable sweetness. Its Ecuadorian Cameroon wrapper sheathes a Dominican binder and a Dominican and USA filler. Handmade in the Dominican Republic, the La Aurora Especiales is a limited edition cigar whose blend was created after Manuel Inoa, the master blender for La Aurora, received input from over 100 cigar retailers. It took six years to develop the blend for this box worthy cigar. And it was worth the wait.

The La Aurora Family Creed Perseverancia opens with rich notes of cedar, roasted nuts, earth, and baking spice, complemented by a touch of natural sweetness that keeps the profile balanced and refined. Medium-bodied with layers of complexity, it delivers the smooth, approachable character that has become a hallmark of La Auroras Dominican craftsmanship.The third release in La Auroras Family Creed Series, Perseverancia honors the perseverance and determination that have shaped the family-owned company for generations. Handmade in the Dominican Republic, the blend features an Ecuadorian wrapper over a Dominican binder and Dominican, Nicaraguan, and Pennsylvania fillers. As part of this ongoing series celebrating the values behind La Auroras legacy, Perseverancia offers a thoughtful blend that reflects the brands enduring commitment to quality and tradition.

Noticeable notes of wood, cinnamon, nuts, citrus and roasted coffee contribute to this full-bodied cigars deep complexity and long finish. A reddish Ecuadorian Sumatra-seed wrapper covers an Ecuadorian Sumatra binder and filler leaves from Colombia, Nicaragua, and the Dominican Republic. Every leaf in this unique blend has been aged for 12 years. The cigars were rolled in 2022 and allowed to rest for two years so that the leaves' flavors could meld and create the cigar's uniquely satisfying flavor profile. Handmade at the La Aurora Cigars factory in the Dominican Republic. The La Aurora Hors D'Age 2022 Toro is a limited edition cigar. Only 650 boxes of 15 cigars per box were made. Order yours today!

The La Aurora Hors d'Age 2024 is the seventh edition of this ultra-premium annual release. It features the same blend as last year's, with an Ecuadorian Sumatra wrapper and binder, and filler tobaccos from Colombia, the Dominican Republic, and Nicaragua. All tobaccos are aged for a minimum of 12 years, with the finished cigars aged an additional year. The name Hors d'Age, meaning “beyond age,” reflects the exceptional maturity and craftsmanship behind this rare, limited release of only 700 boxes.

A medium bodied smoke with a rich complexity and a delicious nutty and creamy profile. The blend features a reddish Cameroon wrapper placed over a binder and filler made exclusively of Dominican tobaccos. Handmade in the Dominican Republic, the La Aurora Preferidos Cameroon Platinum Tubes is an excellent special occasion smoke.

A mild smoke with a toasty and cedar profile and hints of coffee beans. Its USA Connecticut Shade wrapper covers a Dominican binder and a Brazilian, Cameroon, and Dominican filler. Handmade in the Dominican Republic, the La Aurora Preferidos Connecticut Sapphire Tubes received an enviable 91-Rating from Cigar Aficionado.

A medium to full bodied cigar with a cedar and sweet flavor profile. Its dark Brazilian maduro wrapper covers a Dominican binder and filler. Handmade in the Dominican, the La Aurora Preferidos Maduro Ruby Tubes' tobaccos have been aged for 4 years and then aged for 1 more year in rum barrels to develop their unique aroma and flavor.

The La Aurora Puro Vintage 2007 Salomon is the fifth entry into the prestigious brands Puro Vintage series, bringing with it premium 11-year-old tobaccos from four countries. Featuring a Dominican wrapper, Ecuadorian binder and fillers from the Dominican Republic, Nicaragua and Brazil, this full-bodied perfecto contains notes of cedar, coffee and spice, with a smooth complexity only found thanks to the patient and meticulous aging process this luxurious cigar endured before finally landing in your hands over a decade later. This Biennial release is coming out at this years 2026 PCA convention in a limited quantity of just 700 boxes.

A mellow, medium-bodied cigar with a creamy, tobacco sweetness profile accented with spicy and coffee notes. This carefully aged dark chocolatey Ecuadorian maduro wrapper covers a Brazilian binder and a filler made of Dominican, Nicaraguan Criollo, and Brazilian Mata Fina leaves. The La Aurora Puro Vintage 2009 (also known as the 2014) uses tobaccos that have been aged for at least 10 years. When lit this vintage blends deep complexity creates a memorable smoking experience that can only be achieved through careful aging. The cigars are handmade in the Dominican Republic at the La Aurora Cigars world famous cigar factory. This a very limited-edition cigar. Only 1,000 boxes of 8 cigars per box were made. Order yours today!

La Aurora Small Batch Lot No. 007 is an ultra-exclusive release that redefines rarity; just 180 boxes of 10 cigars exist, totaling a mere 1,800 cigars worldwide. Crafted with a Mexican San Andrés wrapper over dual Cameroon and Dominican binders, with an aged filler blend from the Dominican Republic, Nicaragua, and Peru. And the kicker? This tobacco has been aging for a minimum of 12 and up to 21 years. From one of the oldest and most respected cigar houses in the world, this limited gem offers a mouthwatering profile and an approachable price, making it not just collectible, but irresistible.

La Auroras Stravaganza is not for the faint of heart. Packaged in its own wooden coffin case with a plexiglass front, this cigar will turn every head in the room when unveiled; at a whopping 20 x 80 size, the Stravaganza likely dwarfs every cigar youve ever smoked. Luckily, you cannot label it as a mere gimmick, due to La Aurora utilizing the same delicious blend found in the rest of their 1495 line. Contained within this behemoth is a generous helping of Dominican, Nicaraguan, Peruvian and Brazilian fillers, with a Brazilian Mata Fina binder and Ecuadorian Sumatra wrapper providing a rich taste containing notes of earth, cedar and leather. Once you decide to set this stick ablaze, make sure youve set aside the next several hours - you will be busy.

The La Duena Petit Lancero No. 7 is a full-strength long corona which will appeal to the veteran aficionado or the novice looking to step up their smoking game. A dark, maduro USA Connecticut broadleaf wrapper combines with the La Duena's Nicaraguan binder and filler to create robust notes of earth, leather, and pepper. The La Duena is hand crafted at the My Father Cigar factory in Nicaragua.

The Duena Petit Robusto No. 11 is a full-strength toro which will appeal to the veteran aficionado or the novice looking to step up their smoking game. A dark, maduro USA Connecticut broadleaf wrapper combines with the La Duena's Nicaraguan binder and filler to create robust notes of earth, leather, and pepper. The La Duena is hand crafted at the My Father Cigar factory in Nicaragua.

La Estrella Cubana Habano Churchill is a priced-right, medium-strength stick that looks, feels, and tastes like a premium. Handmade in Nicaragua, the La Estrella Cubana Habano starts with Nicaraguan long-fillers that are expertly rolled into a Honduran binder and covered by a brown Habano wrapper. From first puff to last the La Estrella Cubana Habano offers heart-warming notes of coffee and spice.

This full-bodied cigar offers rich notes of coffee, pepper, spice, and a delicious sweetness. The blend consists of a Mexican San Andres wrapper and a Dominican binder and filler. Handmade in the Dominican Republic, the La Flor Dominicana 1994 was crafted to celebrate this popular brand's 20th anniversary.  It received an 88-Rating from Cigar Insider.

A potent yet flavorful smoke with a spicy, peppery, and sweetness profile. Its oily Ecuadorian Corojo maduro wrapper sheaths a Dominican binder and filler. Expertly handmade in the Dominican Republic, the La Flor Dominicana 25th Anniversary was created to celebrate LFD's quarter of a century of producing memorable premium cigars.

A commemorative, medium-bodied cigar with a deep complexity of flavors that creates a self-indulgent smoking experience that must be tried to be believed. Its savory Ecuadorian Sumatra-seed maduro wrapper covers a rare-aged binder from Cotui, which is an area in the Dominican Republic known for its excellent tobacco. The binder holds long-filler leaves sourced from La Flor Dominicana's farms. The cigars are box-pressed and expertly handmade into the La Flor Dominicana's distinct Chisel shape. As its name implies, the La Flor Dominicana 30th Anniversary cigar was crafted to celebrate this family owned and operated cigar company's three decades of creating excellent cigars. This is a limited-edition cigar. Only 2,000 boxes of 60 cigars per box were made. Order yours today!

A potent and flavorful smoke with delicious notes of sweetness, spice, and coffee with an underlying creaminess. Made of 100% premium Dominican tobacco this exclusive release cigar sports a savory maduro wrapper. Handmade in the Dominican Republic. The cigars are nested in a collectible emerald-green box, which bears a silhouette of cigar crafter Litto Gomez and his first name in script. The La Flor Dominicana 55th Anniversary Emeraude Litto Gomez was crafted to celebrate the Tobacconists' Association of America's (TAA) 55th anniversary. The TAA is a group of the top tobacconists in the nation. It consists of about 80 retailers and 40 manufacturers, which Neptune Cigars is proud to be a member of.

Apollonia presents a distinct look for La Flor Dominicana, and that's precisely the point. The different appearance matches the dramatically different blend. Created as a 2025 TAA exclusive, this cigar features a Cameroon wrapper over Dominican binder and fillers, a combination unused since the Cameroon Cabinet. This wrapper was selected to emphasize balance as opposed to the strength LFD is typically known for. It was blended by Tony Gomez and named after his mother.The Cameroon wrapper softens the profile, bringing a natural sweetness and light spice, while the Dominican core keeps everything smooth and creamy. Production is limited, with only 1,500 boxes made available exclusively through the Tobacconists' Association of America's group of retailers, giving retailers and aficionados alike a real collectors item from La Flor Dominicana's 2025 lineup.

A full-bodied cigar with a rich complexity and hints of spice and nuts. Its rugged Cameroon wrapper that has been aged for 4 years covers a Dominican binder and a Nicaraguan and Dominican filler. Handmade in the Dominican Republic, the La Flor Dominicana Cameroon Cabinet is Litto Gomez's, (founder and owner of La Flor Dominicana) favorite cigar. With just one puff you'll soon discover why it's his favorite.

A potent and spicy cigar accented with notes of coffee, roasted nuts, and dark chocolate. Its reddish Nicaraguan maduro wrapper covers a Habano Ecuadorian binder and a Dominican Republic filler. The La Flor Dominicana Capitulo II is the follow up to the popular Capitulo I but with a different wrapper and binder for a completely different yet satisfying smoking experience. Handmade in the Dominican Republic.

Dark, dense, and unmistakably bold, the La Flor Dominicana Carbon Flower delivers a full-bodied profile built around notes of black pepper, charred earth, espresso, and a deep mineral edge. It's a powerful, concentrated smoke that leans into intensity while maintaining the signature balance fans of the brand expect.This limited release from La Flor Dominicana is inspired by the rare “carbon flower” phenomenon found in coal mines, reflected in both its name and presentation. Crafted in the Dominican Republic, the cigar continues LFD's tradition of emphasizing strength and character, offering a distinctive, small-batch release designed for experienced smokers.

A full-bodied cigar with a peppery, earthy, and sweetness profile. Its dark Brazilian wrapper covers a Connecticut binder and Dominican filler. The La Flor Dominicana Chapter I Chisel is the first cigar blended by Litto Gomezs son, Antonio Gomez. Handmade in the Dominican Republic.

A full-strength cigar that offers notes of espresso, spice, and leather. Its reddish Nicaraguan Habano maduro wrapper covers a Dominican binder and a Nicaraguan and Dominican filler. Handmade in the Dominican Republic, the La Flor Dominicana Colorado Oscuro expertly balances flavor and strength to create a memorable smoking experience.

A  full-bodied smoke that delivers palate pleasing notes of cedar, citrus, coffee, and pepper. Its smooth Ecuadorian Habano wrapper covers a Dominican Republic binder and filler. Handmade in the Dominican Republic, the La Flor Dominicana Double Press is a limited-edition cigar that is known for its flawless draw and sharp burn.

A medium bodied cigar with savory notes of cedar, roasted nuts and touches of black pepper. The blend consists of a Dominican binder and filler covered by a smooth Ecuadorian Habano wrapper. Handmade in the Dominican Republic, the La Flor Dominicana El Carajon is right-sized for an after lunch treat or when walking the dog.

A potent cigar with tasty notes of cocoa, coffee, leather, and spice. Its Ecuadorian Sumatra wrapper covers a Dominican Republic binder and filler. The La Flor Dominicana Ligero Cabinet Oscuro offers a bold smoking experience with a smooth finish. Handmade in the Dominican Republic.

A potent cigar with a spicy, earthy, and sweetness profile. The blend consists of a warm-tan Ecuadorian Sumatra-seed wrapper that covers a Dominican binder and filler. The La Flor Dominicana Ligero Natural is handmade in the Dominican Republic.

A potent cigar with a spicy, earthy, and sweetness profile. The blend consists of a warm-tan Ecuadorian Sumatra-seed wrapper covering a Dominican binder and filler. The La Flor Dominicana Ligero Natural is handmade in the Dominican Republic.

A potent smoke that offers up rich notes of spice, earth, and underscored by an irresistible sweetness. Its oily USA Connecticut Broadleaf wrapper covers a Dominican Republic binder and filler. The La Flor Dominicana Maduro Cabinet is perfect for seasoned aficionados who enjoy a robust smoke or novices wishing to expand their smoking portfolio. Handmade in the Dominican Republic.

For the 6th year La Flor Dominicana is producing their Special Football Edition for the market hosting the Super Bowl, this year is Neptunes hometown of MIAMI. This has become one of their most anticipated limited edition releases garnering significant acclaim. This product is available only to retailers in the state hosting the super bowl.

A spicy start that tames quickly, natural sweetness, coffee, leather, and a subtle floral retrohale describe the La Flor Dominicana Oro Chisels notes, all wrapped up in a smooth, clean finish. This medium to full-bodied cigar features a high priming sun-grown Nicaraguan Habano wrapper cultivated on LFD's own La Canela farm, draped over a rich blend of Dominican binder and filler tobaccos. This vitola and LFDs Oro Natural #6 share the same blend.

Natural sweetness, coffee, leather, and a subtle floral retrohale ride over a spicy opening that mellows, finishing smooth and clean. The La Flor Dominicana Oro Maduro delivers a rich and flavorful experience due to its oily, high-priming sun-grown Nicaraguan Habano wrapper and a robust core of Dominican binder and filler from LFD's La Canela farm. Unapologetically full-bodied, it offers depth, strength, and balance in equal measure. Also available in natural, for a still potent, but softer experience.

The Salomon Unico is a work of art that showcases the incredible talent of the cigar rollers of the Dominican Republic. The country boasts some of the finest rollers in the entire world.  The La Flor Dominicana factory has long been a destination for the very best of the best.  The Salomon Único contains 10 amazing works of art.  Each box is unique, and within each box are 10 different beautifully crafted artistic versions of their legendary Salomon.  The cigars in the picture are an example of what you may find inside a box of Salomon Unico, but each cigar is unique and you will not be receiving the exact designs as pictured.

The La Flor Dominicana Special Football Edition 2019 is a box-pressed, medium strength cigar that is expertly hand crafted in the Dominican Republic. Its touchdown worthy Ecuadorian Habano wrapper is adorned with a contrasting colored leaf made to resemble a football. This unique wrapper is teamed up with a Dominican Republic binder and filler to deliver an all-star roster of flavors that includes cedar, cocoa, earth, and nuts. For the past five years, La Flor Dominicana has issued a special football edition cigar to commemorate the Super Bowl. This limited-edition cigar is only available in the city that hosts the NFL Championship Game. In 2019, the big game was held in Atlanta, Georgia.

A full-bodied cigar with a spicy, earthy, creamy, and sweetness profile. Its light-brown Nicaraguan wrapper covers a Dominican binder and filler. The wrapper is adorned with a Connecticut Broadleaf maduro leaf at the tip and foot to give this perfecto its striking appearance. The La Flor Dominicana TCFKA “M” Natural is handmade in the Dominican Republic.  “TCFKA “M” stands for “The Cigar Formally Known as “M” in case you are wondering.

La Galera 80th Anniversary Limited Edition is a full-bodied Dominican cigar featuring a dark and oily Mexican San Andres wrapper housing a Dominican Corojo binder and three types of premium Dominican fillers. Notes of chocolate, fruit, earth and spice can be found throughout this complex blend. This limited-edition cigar is available in a special 14-count molded box containing two different vitolas, with 7 Cortador (6 1/8 x 52) and 7 robusto El Lector (5 x 54). Only 4,000 boxes were produced, so be sure to acquire one now while theyre still around!

The La Galera Habano Cabeza Caracol Churchill is a medium-strength stick that offers up an enticing, aromatic smoke that cannot be denied. An Ecuadorian Habano wrapper is paired up with a Dominican Corojo binder and an irresistible blend of Dominican Piloto Cubano, Criollo 98, and Pelo de Oro fillers to create delicious notes of cream, cedar, and coffee.

Brought to you by acclaimed master blender Jochy Blanco, the La Galera Habano Perillas Lancero is an expertly constructed, medium-bodied Dominican cigar made at Tabacalera Palma. Featuring a gorgeous copper-colored Ecuadorian Habano wrapper on top of a Dominican Corojo binder and a luscious mix of Dominican Piloto Cubano, Criollo 98 and Pelo de Oro fillers, this delectably complex long panatela will dazzle your palate with notes of cedar, coffee, and caramel.

A mild smoke that offers notes of sweetness with touches of spice and a creamy finish. Its Ecuadorian Connecticut Shade wrapper covers a Piloto Cubano binder and a Dominican, Dominican Piloto Cubano, and Criollo '98 filler. Made at the Tabacalera Palma factory in the Dominican Republic.

A potent yet balanced cigar with savory notes of sweetness, spice, and a subtle creaminess. Its oily Ecuadorian Habano maduro wrapper covers a binder and filler made of Piloto Cubano and Criollo '98 leaves. The La Galera Year of the Dragon cigar was crafted to celebrate the Lunar New Year (aka the Chinese New Year). The cigars are handmade at Jose “Jochy” Blanco's Tabacalera Palma in the Dominican Republic. This is a limited edition cigar. Only 2,040 boxes of 10 cigars per box were made. Order yours today.

Chinese zodiac releases have become a familiar lane in the premium cigar world, with many brands using the annual cycle to showcase limited blends and distinctive packaging. For 2026, La Galera returns to that space with its own Year of the Horse release, marking a notable moment for the brand as it joins a category often dominated by larger names.La Galera's roots are firmly Dominican, drawing on generations of tobacco growing and blending through the Jochy Blanco family. Known for blends that highlight Dominican character, The Year of the Horse pushes the boundaries a little bit, utilizing a Brazilian Arapiraca wrapper over a Dominican olor binder and four Dominican fillers: criollo 98, olor, pelo de oro, and piloto Cubano seed. That blend gives the cigar a richer, darker edge than a typical Dominican profile. The Brazilian Arapiraca wrapper adds depth and natural sweetness, while the Dominican olor binder keeps everything structured and aromatic. The mix of Criollo 98, Olor, Pelo de Oro, and Piloto Cubano fillers brings balance. Earthy, slightly spicy, and smooth notes work in harmony to create a layered flavor that tastes full without becoming heavy. Pick up this limited edition stick while you can.

A well-balanced cigar with a rich creaminess and sweetness accented with spicy notes. Its savory Ecuadorian Habano maduro wrapper covers a Nicaraguan binder and a Dominican and Nicaraguan filler. Handmade in Miami, Florida at the famed El Titan de Bronze factory, the La Gloria Cubana 8th Street Toro is a full-bodied smoke with a rich complexity and a long finish.

This medium-bodied smoke's leathery, woody, earthy, citrusy, along with white pepper and vanilla notes contribute to its rich complexity. Its Ecuadorian Habano wrapper drapes a “Corojo de Oro” binder, and a filler composed of Brazilian Mata Fina, Dominican Piloto Cubano, and Nicaraguan Ometepe leaves. This unique four-nation blend works in concert to provide a one-of-a-kind smoking experience. The La Gloria Cubana Corojo de Oro Limited Edition Toro pairs well with Rye, IPA, or Red Zinfandel. The cigars are handmade in the Dominican Republic.

A medium-bodied cigar with a savory profile that delivers notes of tobacco sweetness, earth, citrus, cedar, and spice. Its sun-grown Criollo de Oro wrapper covers a USA Connecticut Broadleaf binder and a Honduran and Nicaraguan filler. The La Gloria Cubana Criollo de Oro is named after its proprietary wrapper that is grown in Mao, Dominican Republic, an area known for having a climate best suited for growing tobacco. Criollo de Oro is prized for its distinctively robust flavors. The cigars are handmade in the Dominican Republic.

A medium to full-bodied cigar that offers delicious notes of cedar, almonds, and pepper. It features a dark Nicaraguan wrapper draped over a Honduran binder and filler. Handmade in Nicaragua, the La Gloria Cubana Esteli is named after the esteemed city which is home to the skilled artisans who make this magnificent cigar.

Toasted cedar, sweet spice, and a touch of earth set the tone for the La Gloria Cubana Intención, a medium-bodied smoke that is as intentional as its name suggests. The profile stays steady throughout, with a gentle balance of sweetness and spice that gives it a classic feel.Intención is a new regular production release from La Gloria Cubana, produced by José “Pepin” Garcia at the My Father Cigars Factory in Nicaragua. It adds a modern expression to the brand's portfolio while keeping the familiar character that has long defined La Gloria Cubana.

The La Gloria Cubana Los Gloriosos is a premium cigar that marks the return of master blender Ernesto Perez-Carrillo to the brand he originally helped build. A medium-to-full-bodied cigar delivering layered notes of leather, espresso, spice, and cocoa, all culminating in a smooth finish. Handcrafted at Casa Carrillo, this cigar blends tradition with a bold, modern profile, offering a rich and complex smoking experience from start to finish. It features an Ecuadorian Habano wrapper, a Nicaraguan Jalapa binder, and a filler blend of Nicaraguan tobaccos from Jalapa and Condega paired with Dominican leaves.

A medium-to-full-bodied cigar delivering layered notes of leather, espresso, spice, and cocoa, all culminating in a smooth finish. Handcrafted at Casa Carrillo, this cigar blends tradition with a bold, modern profile, offering a rich and complex smoking experience from start to finish. A medium-bodied cigar with a spicy, peppery, earthy, and sweetness profile and a long woody finish. Its mouthwatering Ecuadorian Ligero Sumatra wrapper covers a USA Connecticut Broadleaf binder and a Honduran, Nicaraguan and Dominican Piloto Cubano medio tiempo filler. The medio tiempo leaf is the top most leaf on a tobacco plant. It receives the most exposure from the sun, and it is known for its intensity and complexity. It is also rare and hard-to-get. Handmade in the Dominican Republic, the La Gloria Cubana Medio Tiempo is one flavorful cigar that you will want to smoke time after time so be sure to order a box or two.

The La Gloria Cubana Natural Charlemagne is part of the iconic non-Cuban La Gloria Cubana brand that was established in Miami, FL during the 1970s, and it is part of many aficionados' regular rotation. Its lovely red-hued Ecuadorian wrapper is skillfully placed over a Nicaraguan binder and a filler made of Dominican Republic and Nicaraguan leaves. This medium-strength double-corona provides a mellow smoking experience with its rich creaminess and sweetness highlighted with a satisfying spiciness. Expertly handmade in the Dominican Republic.

This potent yet flavorful cigar offers rich spicy, earthy, and peppery notes. A Nicaraguan puro with an oily Jalapa Ligero maduro wrapper placed over a Jalapa binder and a Jalapa and Esteli filler. The tobacco leaves for this delicious blend comes from three of Nicaragua's top-tobacco growing regions. The exquisite Jalapa tobacco has been fermented for one year and then aged for two and a half years to allow its strength and flavor to develop. The La Gloria Cubana Serie R Black cigars are hand crafted in Nicaragua.

A flavorful medium-strength cigar with a woody, earthy, spicy profile, and a sweet finish. Its Ecuadorian Sumatra-seed wrapper cloaks a Nicaraguan binder and a Dominican Republic and Nicaraguan filler. The La Gloria Cubana Serie R Natural is handmade in the Dominican Republic.

A flavorful medium-strength cigar with a woody, earthy, spicy profile, and a sweet finish. Its Ecuadorian Sumatra-seed wrapper cloaks a Nicaraguan binder and a Dominican Republic and Nicaraguan filler. The La Gloria Cubana Serie R Natural is handmade in the Dominican Republic.

A medium-bodied cigar with notes of earth, spice, and tobacco sweetness. Its delicious, Mexican San Andres Colorado maduro wrapper covers a Nicaraguan binder and a Dominican and Nicaraguan filler. Handmade in the Dominican Republic, the La Gloria Cubana Serie S Robusto Gigante expertly combines cigar-crafting with a savory blend to create a memorable cigar. The cigar pairs well with espresso or single malt whisky.

A flavorful medium-strength cigar with an earthy, nutty, coffee, leathery, spicy, and tobacco sweetness profile. Its Honduran Habano maduro wrapper sheaths an Ecuadorian Sumatra binder, and a Dominican and Nicaraguan filler. The cigars are handmade in the Dominican Republic at the El Credito Cigar Co. Like its predecessor, the blend for the La Gloria Cubana Society Cigar II is based on the feedback of this storied brand's most loyal fans.

A medium to full-strength cigar with a spicy, earthy, toasty and cedar profile and a tobacco aroma. Its Nicaraguan Maduro wrapper covers a Mexican San Andres binder and a three-nation filler. The filler is composed of the following: Brazilian Mata Fina, Dominican Olor and Piloto Cubano and Nicaraguan Jalapa. Handmade in the Dominican Republic, the La Gloria Cubana Spanish Press employs a specially developed press method that helps the cigar maintain is shape and flawless draw.

The La Gloria Cubana Spirit of the Lady Toro is a limited-edition cigar that showcases the legendary craftsmanship that made the storied El Credito cigar factory a globally recognized name in the cigar industry. This box pressed stick features an oily chocolatey Olancho San Agustin Honduran maduro wrapper that has been carefully aged for 7 years before being applied to a 3-year-old Cameroon binder and filler made of Mexican San Andres, Nicaraguan Esteli and Condega, and Dominican Piloto Cubano leaves. Once lit, this specially curated five nation blend delivers memorable notes of earth, cocoa, and cedar with hints of cinnamon. The La Gloria Cubana Spirit of the Lady is handmade in the Dominican Republic. This is a limited-edition premium cigar only 6,000 boxes of 20 cigars per box were made so reserve your box today before this lovely lady gets spirited away.

This medium bodied cigar offers delicious notes of tobacco sweetness, spice, coffee, and a  rich creaminess. Its beautifully aged Ecuadorian wrapper covers a Nicaraguan binder and Dominican and Nicaraguan filler. Handmade in the Dominican Republic. When first released in the '90s, the La Gloria Cubana Natural became an instant favorite among cigar aficionados. Since then, it has enjoyed a permanent spot in most cigar lovers' humidors. Rated 89 (Very Good to Excellent) by Cigar Aficionado Feb. 2008.

Its beautifully aged Ecuadorian wrapper covers a Nicaraguan binder and Dominican and Nicaraguan filler. Handmade in the Dominican Republic. La Instructora Box Pressed features a dark Brazilian Cubra wrapper, which houses a Dominican Piloto binder, and a blended filler made of Dominican Piloto and Criollo 98 tobaccos for a medium-strength smoking experience. Full-bodied, La Instructora offers an intense combination of black pepper, spices, chocolate, and leather.

A medium bodied anniversary cigar with notes of earth, cedar, chocolate, tobacco, and white pepper. This exquisite Nicaraguan puro sports a delectable chocolatey brown wrapper. The La Palina 125 Anos Toro was created to commemorate the 125th Anniversary of La Palina Cigars. The cigars are handmade in Nicaragua by the Oliva Cigar Co. Once rolled, the cigars are placed in collectible glass jars that are reminiscent of the packaging used in the late 1800s and early 1900s.

A full-strength cigar that delivers noticeable notes of earth, leather, cedar, and cocoa. Its rustic Brazilian maduro wrapper covers a Dominican and Nicaraguan binder and filler. Handmade in Honduras by Plasencia Cigars, the La Palina Black Label appeals to veteran aficionados or novices who are seeking to expand their smoking portfolio.

A tasty medium-bodied smoke with a spicy and woody profile and creamy finish. Its Habano wrapper sheathes a Honduran binder and a Nicaraguan and Honduran filler. The La Palina Blue Label offers a bold, flavorful, yet smooth smoking experience.
This exclusive TAA cigar has a dark brown wrapper rolled with a rounded triple cap. Very aromatic, this medium bodied smoke offers mild spice, sweet flavors and a creamy finish.

The La Palina Classic Rosado Lonsdale is a shining example of what over a century of masterful tobacco expertise can offer. Made by General Cigar in the Dominican Republic, this medium to full-bodied lonsdale features a gorgeous Honduran wrapper on top of a Honduran binder and a hearty mix of Dominican, Honduran, and Nicaraguan fillers to provide a smooth and complex profile containing notes of cedar, nuts, figs, and white pepper.

A delicious natural sweetness accented with bold notes of a spice will greet you when lit up this full-bodied cigar. Its deep tan Ecuadorian Corojo wrapper covers an Ecuadorian binder and a Nicaraguan filler. Expertly handmade, the La Palina Double Digit offers a remarkably satisfying smoking experience at a box worthy price.

The La Palina Family Series Dominican opens with notes of cedar, roasted nuts, earth, and baking spice, complemented by a subtle natural sweetness that carries through the finish. Medium-bodied and balanced, it showcases the richness of Dominican Corojo while adding depth from the Mexican San Andrés binder and a blend of Dominican and Nicaraguan fillers.The first release in La Palinas new Family Series, this limited edition honors the people and factory partners who have helped shape the brand over the years. Produced at Tabacalera La Isla in the Dominican Republic by Hostos Fernandez, the cigar celebrates one of La Palinas longest-standing relationships, inaugurating a series dedicated to the companys extended cigar family.

This medium bodied smoke offers rich notes of coffee, nuts, and cedar. Its savory Ecuadorian Corojo '98 wrapper covers an Ecuadorian Habano binder and a Nicaraguan filler. The La Palina Family Series Miami Babe is expertly hand crafted in Miami, Florida at the El Titan de Bronze factory, which uses traditional Cuban rolling methods. The La Palina Family Series was one of the first releases by Bill Paley who is the owner of La Palina Cigars. The Miami is a re-imagined version of the original, and like its predecessor has become a hit among aficionados.

A delicious and complex medium-bodied smoke that delivers notes of spice, cedar, nuts, and coffee. Its Ecuadorian Corojo '98 wrapper covers an Ecuadorian Habano binder and a Nicaraguan filler. The La Palina Family Series Miami Pasha Coffin is handmade at the famed El Titan de Bronze factory in Miami, Florida. Once rolled, each cigar is nested in a wooden coffin to protect its exquisite wrapper.

A mild cigar with a sweet profile accompanied by subtle notes of spice.  Its double-claro Honduran candela wrapper covers a Honduran binder and a Nicaraguan filler. The La Palina Fuego Verde is an excellent smoke that can be enjoyed in the morning with a warm cup of coffee. Handmade in the Dominican Republic.

The La Palina Goldie is a smooth medium-strength cigar that features an eye-catching fantail at the head. Its alluring light-brown Ecuadorian Habano wrapper gets draped over an Ecuadorian binder and a filler composed of leaves from Nicaragua and the Dominican Republic. The specially selected three-nation blend offers up spicy and woody notes with an underlying sweetness. The blend features the rare and prized Medio Tiempo leaves, known for their rich flavor. The La Palina Goldie is handmade at the famed El Titan de Bronze factory in Miami, Florida.
