The La Palina Goldie Laguito No. 1 is a medium-strength long panatela the features an eye-catching fantail at the head. Its alluring light-brown Ecuadorian Habano wrapper is placed over an Ecuadorian binder and a filler composed of leaves from Nicaragua and the Dominican Republic. This specially selected three-nation blend offers up spicy and woody notes with an underlying sweetness. The blend uses the rare and prized Medio Tiempo leaves, which are known for being rich in flavor. The La Palina Laguito is handmade at the famed El Titan de Bronze factory in Miami, Florida.

The La Palina Goldie Laguito No. 6 is a medium strength toro the features an alluring light brown Ecuadorian Habano wrapper placed over an Ecuadorian binder and a filler composed of leaves from Nicaragua and the Dominican Republic. This specially selected three-nation blend offers up spicy and woody notes with an underlying sweetness. The blend uses the rare and prized Medio Tiempo leaves, which are known for being rich in flavor. The La Palina Laguito are handmade at the famed El Titan de Bronze factory in Miami, Florida. It received a “90 Rating” from Cigar Aficionado.

A medium to full-strength cigar with a peppery, spicy, and earthy profile. Its Honduran Corojo wrapper drapes a Honduran Criollo double binder, and a filler made of Nicaraguan Corojo and Criollo leaves. The La Palina KB Series offers an invigorating but not overwhelming smoking experience. When it was first developed, it was too strong for Bill Paley, the brand's owner, to finish it (“KB” stands for 'Kill Bill”).

A medium to full-strength cigar with a peppery, spicy, and earthy profile. Its Honduran Corojo wrapper drapes a Honduran Criollo double binder, and a filler made of Nicaraguan Corojo and Criollo leaves. The La Palina KB Series offers an invigorating but not overwhelming smoking experience. When it was first developed, it was too strong for Bill Paley, the brand's owner, to finish it (“KB” stands for 'Kill Bill”).

Hand crafted in the famed El Titan de Bronze factory in Miami, Florida, the La Palina Mr. Sam Robusto is a medium-strength cigar created to honor Sam Paley the founder of La Palina Cigars. The Mr. Sam sports a Colorado Ecuadorian wrapper with a Nicaraguan binder and filler for a well-balanced combination of pepper, cedar, spice, and natural tobacco flavors.

With its superb construction, The La Palina Nicaragua Connecticut Robusto is a medium-strength stick that is a testament to La Palina's commitment to craftsmanship. The La Palina Nicaragua Connecticut's natural Ecuadorian Connecticut shade wrapper is perfectly paired with a binder and filler from Nicaragua to create a medium bodied smoke that hints of earth, pepper, and nuts.

The La Palina Silver Label Toro is a full-bodied premium cigar that was created to satisfy this storied brand's fans' demand for a stronger but flavorful stick. This potent but not overwhelming toro uses a Honduran Habano wrapper, a Costa Rican binder, and a hearty mix of Nicaraguan, Honduran, and Costa Rican fillers that provides a bold yet smooth smoking profile. The La Palina Silver Label is handmade in Honduras.

This mild smoke offers notes of leather, nutmeg, and citrus. Its Honduran Connecticut-seed wrapper covers a Mexican San Andres binder and a Dominican Piloto Cubano and Mexican San Andres filler. The La Palina White Label cigar is handmade in Honduras.

The La Rosa De Sandiego Connecticut Inmenso XO is a hefty stick that offers a Cubanesque smoking experience. Its delectable light-tan Ecuadorian Connecticut Shade wrapper has a slightly oily sheen to it, which telegraphs its flavorful profile. Underneath the wrapper is an Ecuadorian binder and long-filler leaves from Nicaragua. Upon lighting, this medium-strength, medium-bodied toro offers notes of cedar with hints of citrus and an overall creaminess to create a very classical profile that will appeal to both the traditional as well as the contemporary smoker. The La Rosa de Sandiego Connecticut is expertly handmade in Nicaragua by American Caribbean Cigars.

The La Rosa De Sandiego Connecticut Toro Gordo is a hefty stick that offers a Cubanesque smoking experience. Its delectable light-tan Ecuadorian Connecticut Shade wrapper has a slightly oily sheen to it, which telegraphs its flavorful profile. Underneath the wrapper is an Ecuadorian binder and long-filler leaves from Nicaragua. Upon lighting, this medium-strength, medium-bodied toro offers notes of cedar with hints of citrus and an overall creaminess to create a very classical profile that will appeal to both the traditional as well as the contemporary smoker. The La Rosa de Sandiego Connecticut is expertly handmade in Nicaragua by American Caribbean Cigars.

With its rich complexity of flavors and excellent construction, the La Rosa De Sandiego Habano Robusto recalls the classical Cuban cigars of days gone by. Its reddish, mouthwatering Ecuadorian Habano wrapper drapes an Ecuadorian binder and a filler consisting of Nicaraguan and USA Pennsylvania tobaccos. Once lit, this full-strength, medium to full-bodied stick delivers warm notes of coffee and oak with touches of chocolate. This premium cigar will appeal to the veteran aficionado, but it is a great smoke for novice's who wish to expand their smoking portfolio. The La Rosa De Sandiego Habano is hand crafted by American Caribbean Cigars in Nicaragua.

A medium bodied Honduran puro with a complexity of flavors that will please your palate as well as your wallet. Its savory Criollo maduro wrapper covers a binder and filler made of top-shelf Honduran tobacco. Once rolled, each cigar is encased by an actual tobacco leaf instead of cellophane. The Leaf by Oscar 10th Anniversary Criollo was created to mark this ever popular brand's first decade. The cigars are handmade in Honduras.

The distinctive Leaf by Oscar line of cigars is introducing a lovely Limited-Edition Connecticut Broadleaf blend to its lineup. This hand-rolled full-strength Honduran was produced with just 1,500 boxes. According to the signature style of the line, each cigar is wrapped in a natural tobacco leaf, giving it a distinct look. Under the oily Broadleaf wrapper is a well-packed Honduran filler that repeats the excellence of the regular blends; think lots of smoke, slow burn, and a draw with just enough resistance. Beyond its visual appeal, the Leaf by Oscar line is loved by its smokers for its quality and consistency.

A medium-strength cigar with tantalizing woody, nutty, and peppery notes. Its smooth Ecuadorian Connecticut Shade wrapper covers a Honduran binder and filler. Instead of cellophane, the Leaf by Oscar Connecticut is sheathed in a rustic-looking tobacco leaf, which you remove to reveal the actual cigar. It is a great morning smoke that will appeal to both the veteran and novice smoker. The cigars are handmade in Honduras.

This medium-strength cigar has a peppery profile accented by woody and nutty notes. Its natural Corojo wrapper covers a Honduran binder and filler. Handmade in Honduras, the Leaf by Oscar Corojo is a delightful smoke that provides a palate-pleasing smoking experience. Instead of cellophane, the cigar is encased in an actual tobacco leaf, which you remove prior to smoking.

A well-balanced, medium-strength cigar with a spicy, earthy, coffee profile and a toasty aroma. Its savory Nicaraguan maduro wrapper cloaks a Honduran binder and filler. Handmade in Honduras. Instead of cellophane, the Leaf by Oscar Maduro is cloaked in an actual tobacco leaf, which you remove prior to lighting.

A potent yet flavorful smoke that delivers deep woody, earthy, and peppery notes with refreshing hints of citrus. Its Ecuadorian Sumatra-seed wrapper is combined with a Honduran binder and filler. Handmade in Honduras. Instead of cellophane, the Leaf by Oscar Sumatra is sheathed in an actual tobacco leaf, which you remove prior to lighting.

The Luciano Élevé Sublime is crafted in a single vitola and produced in the Dominican Republic at an undisclosed factory. Its blend draws from multiple growing regions, though the specific tobaccos remain undisclosed—allowing the cigar's balance and construction to speak for itself. Released in limited quantities, it also marks one of the first projects developed under Luciano Cigars' new partnership within the Constella Group. Limited production of just 1,420 boxes.

Handmade in Nicaragua at the Luciano Cigars Factory. The Luciano Foreign Affair is a well balanced medium strength cigar with an Ecuadorian Sumatra wrapper, dual binders from Nicaragua and Ecuador and fillers from Costa Rica, Dominican Republic and Nicaragua.

Constella Group and Luciano Cigars team up for a new PCA debut with The Machinist, a release built around a deliberately technical blend. The blend uses a Mexican San Andrés viso wrapper, a dual binder of Ecuadorian Sumatra viso and Indonesian Sumatra, and a filler that includes tobacco from Pennsylvania, the Dominican Republic, and South Africa. The goal here is precision; each leaf is selected to play a specific role rather than overpowering the whole.

The Macanudo 1968 robusto is a very aromatic stick, with an oily, medium brown Honduran San Agustin wrapper. The fillers are Dominican and Nicaraguan Ometepe leaves; the binder is a Connecticut Habano. With its flawless construction, this is a medium to full bodied Macanudo that is far more complex than the rest of the Macanudo line.

Cream, toasted nuts, cedar, and a light touch of pepper define the Macanudo Ecuadorian Shade, offering a smooth, balanced profile with a little more character than a traditional mellow smoke. The finish stays clean and refined, making it a cigar that is very easy to enjoy for seasoned smokers and novices alike.This new release from Macanudo builds on the brand's reputation for approachable flavor while introducing an Ecuadorian Shade wrapper for extra nuance and aroma. Crafted for smokers who enjoy classic smoothness with a modern twist, it brings a fresh flavor to Macanudo's portfolio.

Featuring rare French tobacco from the Mugron River Valley near Bordeaux, the Macanudo Emissary France is the brand's first cigar to include tobacco from the region. Grown in a Mediterranean climate near the salty Atlantic breeze, this leaf adds a unique character shaped by the region's distinctive terroir of salt and dark berries. The medium-bodied blend is completed with aged tobaccos from four other countries, each matured between four and ten years to deliver a refined, globally inspired smoking experience.

A medium-bodied smoke with soothing notes of vanilla, cedar, nuts, and a hint of fruitiness. Its Ecuadorian Connecticut Shade wrapper drapes a USA Connecticut Broadleaf binder, and a filler made of Brazilian Mata Fina, Dominican Olor, Dominican Piloto Cubano and Jalapa, Nicaragua leaves. The cigar's binder was aged in French Oak barrels that once contained Flint Knoll's 2019 Royal Appointment Cabernet Sauvignon. The wine left its distinct flavors on the barrels, which was then passed on to the tobacco. Aging the tobacco in these barrels adds a flavorful dimension and complexity to the cigars profile to create a “one-of-a-kind smoking experience.” The Macanudo Estate Reserve Flint Knoll No. 2 cigars are handmade in the Dominican Republic.

The Macanudo Heritage Reserve Churchill is a splendid premium cigar made of carefully aged tobacco. Its smooth, tasty Honduran natural wrapper covers a Honduran binder and a filler composed of vintage Honduran and Nicaraguan leaves. Once rolled, the cigar is aged for two years to allow its unique flavor profile to develop. This medium-bodied yet well-balanced stick offers a complexity of flavors with rich notes of cedar, cocoa, wood, and subtle hints of spice. The Macanudo Heritage Reserve is handmade in the Dominican Republic.

The pleasant sweetness and aroma of Macanudo Maduro in a small size. They say good things come in small packages! Comes in a box of 10 tins of 10 cigars. This small cigar is well constructed, mild and very satisfying.

A mild to medium-bodied smoke with rich notes of cedar, coffee, and spice. Its USA Connecticut Broadleaf maduro wrapper drapes a Mexican San Andres binder and a Dominican Republic Piloto Cubano and Mexican filler. The Macanudo Maduro is handmade in the Dominican Republic.

A mild to medium-bodied smoke with rich notes of cedar, coffee, and spice. Its USA Connecticut Broadleaf maduro wrapper drapes a Mexican San Andres binder and a Dominican Republic Piloto Cubano and Mexican filler. The Macanudo Maduro is handmade in the Dominican Republic.

This Double Corona is a beautiful, dark, oily cigar with sweet, pronounced flavors. Whilst the wrapper is very dark, the Macanudo Maduro is not a strong cigar due to the mild to medium blend of Dominican and Mexican fillers and Connecticut Shade binder.

A potent, full-bodied cigar with a spicy, earthy, fruity, coffee profile and a hint of sweetness. Its muscular USA Connecticut Broadleaf maduro wrapper covers a Honduran binder and a Brazilian, Nicaraguan, and Dominican Republic filler. The wrapper comes from a 1997 crop, which is considered one of the best grown. The Macanudo Maduro Vintage 1997 offers a balanced smoking experience. Each cigar comes with an eye-catching collectible metal band that serves double duty as a cigar stand. The cigars are handmade in the Dominican Republic.

Earth, baking spice, cedar, and subtle sweetness lead the profile of the Macanudo Sumatra, delivering a medium-bodied experience with richer texture and more pronounced complexity. A gentle pepper note and woody finish give it structure without overwhelming the palate.This addition to the Macanudo lineup uses a Sumatra wrapper to create a bolder, more expressive take on the brand's traditionally smooth style. Designed for everyday approachability and fuller flavor, it offers a balanced step up for smokers looking to explore beyond the classic Macanudo profile.

A mild cigar with a nutty, creamy profile and a sweet cedar aroma. Its USA Connecticut Shade wrapper drapes a Connecticut Habano binder and a Honduran, Nicaraguan and Dominican Republic filler. Its exceptional proprietary wrapper comes from a crop that was harvested in 2006. The Macanudo Vintage 2006 offers a balanced smoking experience. Each cigar is adorned with a collectible metal band that serves as a cigar rest. The cigars are handmade in the Dominican Republic.

The Matilde Limited Exposure No. 3 is the latest installment in the experimental Limited Exposure series from Matilde Cigars, led by founder José Seijas. Like previous releases in the series, this cigar is produced in small quantities and designed to showcase unique blends and creative concepts that fall outside the company's regular portfolio.Crafted in the Dominican Republic, the Limited Exposure No. 3 allows the blending team room to experiment with different tobaccos and flavor profiles. This blend differs from even the other Limited Exposures. While Matilde blends typically lean heavily Dominican (around 80%, according to Enrique Seijas), No. 3 takes a different approach, built on a 50/50 split of Dominican and Central American tobaccos. The result is a distinctive, limited-production cigar that offers enthusiasts a chance to experience another one-off creation from one of the industry's most respected blenders.

A full-strength yet flavorful cigar that offers delicious notes of cocoa with touches of leather, sweetness, and spice. Its imposing Mexican San Andres maduro wrapper sheaths an Ecuadorian Habano binder and Nicaraguan filler. The blend was developed by Joel and Edel Gomez-Sanchez, third-generation cigar crafters and Micallef Cigar's exclusive blenders. The cigars are handmade at the Micallef Cigars factory in Nicaragua. The Micallef Black is known for delivering a smooth smoking indulgence that packs a punch, and it is available at a wallet-pleasing price.

A delicious creaminess with hints of spice add complexity to this medium-strength cigar's overall sweetness. Its Mexican San Andres Sumatra wrapper covers an Ecuadorian Habano binder and filler leaves from Nicaragua and the Dominican Republic. The Micallef Blue is an excellent smoke offered at an appealing price. The cigars are handmade in the Dominican Republic.

The Micallef Color Blend Bundles from Micallef Cigars open with a straightforward mix of earth, gentle spice, and soft natural sweetness, settling into a balanced, medium-bodied profile that stays consistent from start to finish. The character is approachable but still layered enough to keep each draw interesting, with a clean, steady finish.These cigars are built using a mixed long and short fillers (a Cuban sandwich), combining select tobaccos from the Color Series production runs. Rolled in Estelí, Nicaragua, they use a Sumatra wrapper over a Nicaraguan binder, offering a practical, everyday expression of the brand's core quality without overcomplicating the experience.

The Micallef Color Blend Bundles from Micallef Cigars open with a straightforward mix of earth, gentle spice, and soft natural sweetness, settling into a balanced, medium-bodied profile that stays consistent from start to finish. The character is approachable but still layered enough to keep each draw interesting, with a clean, steady finish.These cigars are built using a mixed long and short fillers (a Cuban sandwich), combining select tobaccos from the Color Series production runs. Rolled in Estelí, Nicaragua, they use a Sumatra wrapper over a Nicaraguan binder, offering a practical, everyday expression of the brand's core quality without overcomplicating the experience.

A mild smoke with a buttery profile and notes of spice and earth. Its Ecuadorian Connecticut Shade wrapper covers an aged Nicaraguan Habano binder and Nicaraguan and Dominican long filler leaves. Handmade in Nicaragua, the Micallef Connecticut offers a crisp, mellow smoking experience that is perfect any time of day.

This medium bodied cigar offers deep notes of cedar, earth, leather, and spice. Its Mexican San Andres Sumatra wrapper drapes an Ecuadorian Habano binder and aged Dominican, Nicaraguan, and Panamanian long filler leaves. Handmade in Nicaragua, the Micallef Experiencia is known for its traditional look, feel, and taste that will appeal to the contemporary aficionado.

A full-bodied smoke with smooth notes of cedar, coffee, earth, and nuts. Its flawless Ecuadorian Habano wrapper covers a Nicaraguan binder and select Dominican, Honduran, and Nicaraguan filler leaves. Expertly hand crafted in Nicaragua, the Micallef Gomez Sanchez Leyenda is considered master blender Don Pedro Gomezs proudest achievement.

The Micallef Green opens with layered notes of dried fruit, spice, cocoa, and coffee, showcasing a Brazilian Mata Fina wrapper over a San Andrés Negro binder with Dominican, Mexican, and Nicaraguan fillers. This balanced profile expands Micallef's Color Series, crafted to provide everyday smokers with accessible pricing, reliable construction, and the quality expected from the brand's commitment to tradition and consistency.

A medium bodied, box-pressed cigar with an irresistible sweet and spicy profile. Its Nicaraguan Habano wrapper drapes an Ecuadorian Sumatra binder and long-filler leaves from Nicaragua and Honduras. Handmade in Nicaragua, the Micallef Herencia Habano uses tobaccos that have been carefully aged for four (4) years to create a memorable smoking experience.

A medium bodied cigar that delivers notes of spice, cedar, cinnamon, leather and an overall creaminess. Its Mexican San Andres Habano wrapper covers a Sumatran binder and Nicaraguan and Dominican filler. The tobaccos for the Micallef Migdalia have been perfectly aged for 4 years. After it has been rolled, the Migdalia is aged for one more year to ensure it optimizes its distinct flavor profile. The cigars are handmade in Nicaragua.

A medium bodied smoke with a warm woody profile accented by sweetness and fruity notes. Its oily, Mexican San Andres Habano wrapper is aged for 4 years before it is applied to a four-year old Sumatra binder and four-year old Dominican and Nicaraguan filler leaves. The Micallef Migdalia Special Edition Corona was created in honor of International Women's Day (which is celebrated annually on March 8th), and it pays tribute to the women who have made a great impact in all areas of life especially in the cigar industry. The cigar itself is named after Migdalia Sanchez who is the matriarch of the Gomez-Sanchez family, which is Micallef Cigars' manufacturing partner. The cigars are handmade in Nicaragua.

Sweet spice, cocoa, leather, and cedar lead the charge in the Micallef Purple, delivered through a rich, creamy smoke that's both smooth and satisfying. This regular production cigar features a Mexican San Andrés Sumatra wrapper, a bold broadleaf binder, and a filler blend from the Dominican Republic, Mexico, and Nicaragua. Handcrafted at Micallef's own Nicaraguan factory, it proves that yummy flavors and quality construction don't have to come with a premium price tag.

A medium to full-bodied cigar with a spicy and earthy profile underscored by chocolatey, leathery, woody, and molasses notes. Its Mexican San Andres Habano wrapper drapes a Pennsylvania Broadleaf binder and a Nicaraguan and Mexican filler. The pairing of the wrapper and binder contribute to the cigar's enticing spiciness and earthiness. The Micallef Red is handmade in Nicaragua.

A medium bodied cigar that offers deeps notes of oak, leather, fruit, and sweet peppers. Its Habano wrapper covers a Nicaraguan binder and a filler made of Peruvian, Honduran, and Dominican leaves. The tobaccos have been aged for 8 years and gives this exceptional cigar its sophistication and complexity. The Micallef Reserva Privada is handmade by the Gomez Sanchez family in Nicaragua.

A budget-friendly, mild cigar that delivers notes of cedar, leather, nuts, and pepper. Its Mexican San Andres wrapper covers a Honduran binder and a Dominican, Nicaraguan, and Peruvian filler. The Micallef Torcedores offers a smooth and flavorful smoking experience that's perfect during a round of golf or at a weekend BBQ. The cigars are handmade in Nicaragua.

The Micallef White marks a new direction for Micallef Cigars, introducing a more approachable, mellow-leaning profile to the portfolio. Blended in Nicaragua, the cigar features an Ecuadorian Connecticut wrapper over a Connecticut Broadleaf binder and fillers from Nicaragua and the Dominican Republic, positioning it as a smoother counterpoint to some of the brand's richer, fuller-bodied offerings.Designed to emphasize balance and refinement, Micallef White delivers a creamy, medium-bodied experience centered on cedar, light toast, and subtle sweetness, with a gentle touch of pepper in the background. The construction aims for an even burn and easy draw, making it a versatile option for smokers who prefer a softer, more refined expression.

To commemorate a decade of excellence in the industry, My Father has triumphantly released the My Father 10th Anniversary Limited Edition 2018. Presented elegantly in individual wooden coffins, these medium to full-bodied Nicaraguan beauties carry a flawless Ecuadorian Habano Rosado wrapper on top of a Nicaraguan binder and top-shelf Nicaraguan filler. With the expert construction and consistency expected from My Father, along with the booming flavor and complexity the 10 year old brand has become known for, this is set to be an anniversary you will never forget.

Notes of chocolate, pepper, and citrus combine to give this medium bodied cigar its rich complexity. Its Ecuadorian Habano Rosado wrapper drapes a Nicaraguan Criollo 98 binder and Nicaraguan filler that includes the rare Pelo de Oro tobacco. Jose “Pepin” Garcia and his son Jaime developed the blend for the My Father Garcia & Garcia cigar, which is handmade in Nicaragua.

This full-bodied cigar is packed with notes of spice, nuts, chocolate, cedar, and a warm leathery aroma. Its Habano-Rosado wrapper covers a binder and filler made of specially selected Nicaraguan tobaccos. Handmade in Nicaragua, this savory long, lean cigar offers a hearty, meaty smoking indulgence that will appeal to the seasoned aficionado. The My Father No. 4 Lancero received a 94 rating from Cigar Aficionado.

This full-bodied cigar is packed with notes of spice, nuts, chocolate, cedar, and a warm leathery aroma. Its Habano-Rosado wrapper covers a binder and filler made of specially selected Nicaraguan tobaccos. Handmade in Nicaragua, this tasty toro offers a hearty, meaty smoking indulgence that will appeal to the seasoned aficionado. The My Father No. 3 Crema received a 93 rating from Cigar Aficionado  and Cigar Insider.

This full-bodied cigar is packed with notes of spice, nuts, chocolate, cedar, and a warm leathery aroma. Its Habano-Rosado wrapper covers a binder and filler made of specially selected Nicaraguan tobaccos. Handmade in Nicaragua, The My Father No. 6 Toro Gordo offers a hearty, meaty smoking indulgence that will appeal to the seasoned aficionado.

The Nat Sherman Timeless 2019 Limited Edition Toro is a medium-strength premium that is handmade in the Dominican Republic. The Timeless 2019 Limited Edition is only available through retailers who are member of the Tobacconists Association of America (TAA), which is an organization that is composed of approximately 80 retailers and 40 cigar manufacturers. The Nat Sherman Timeless 2019 Limited Edition sports a reddish Dominican wrapper that cloaks a Dominican binder and a filler made of premium tobaccos from Nicaragua and the Dominican Republic.

The Timeless Supreme 749 is a premium Churchill that was specially crafted to please Nat Shermans loyal customers. A medium strength cigar, the Supreme is a box-pressed Nicaraguan puro that is hand crafted in the world famous Plasencia Cigars factory. Medium-bodied, the Supremes delicious coffee, cocoa, and chocolate profile make it a morning or after-dinner smoke.

The Timeless Supreme 546 is a premium cigar that was specially crafted to please Nat Shermans loyal customers. A medium strength cigar, the Supreme is a box-pressed Nicaraguan puro that is hand crafted in the world famous Plasencia Cigars factory. A medium bodied flavor-infused cigar with creamy notes of dark chocolate and espresso. Its Sumatra wrapper covers a Nicaraguan binder and long-filler leaves from the Dominican Republic and Nicaragua. The Oscar Valladares Colaboraciones series brings together a trio of blends developed in partnership with two major titans: E.P. Carrillo and Oliva, alongside Oscar Valladares' own factory. Each cigar in the project reflects the style and influence of its collaborator, resulting in three distinct expressions built around the same 6 x 54 toro format. Produced in limited quantities, each blend features a unique wrapper and composition. Carillo's blend features a U.S.-grown Connecticut Habano wrapper draped over a Sumatra binder, with a balanced blend of Honduran and Nicaraguan fillers at its core. The goal: to highlight how different factories and blending philosophies can shape the final product. With just 1,500 boxes per blend, Colaboraciones stands as a limited small-batch release that emphasizes collaboration, contrast, and craftsmanship.

A medium bodied cigar with a creamy profile accented with spicy, earthy, and sweet notes. Its light-tan Honduran Connecticut Shade wrapper covers a Mexican binder and a Honduran filler. The Oscar Valladares Heaven and Hell Claro cigar offers a smooth and delicious smoking experience that is just heavenly. The cigars are handmade at the Oscar Valladares Tobacco & Co. factory in Danli, Honduras.

A medium-strength cigar made by Oscar Valladares, a well-known cigar crafter, and offered at a wallet-friendly bundle price! It doesn't get any better than that. The Plan B Habano sports a reddish Corojo Habano Colorado wrapper draped over a Honduran binder that's packed with short and long-filler leaves from Honduras and Nicaragua. Hand rolled in Honduras.

A medium to full-strength cigar that delivers notes of vanilla, chocolate, cocoa, and leather. Its Mexican San Andres maduro wrapper surrounds a Honduran binder and a Honduran, Nicaraguan, and Dominican Republic filler. The Oscar Valladares Super Fly is handmade in Danli, Honduras. The brand was inspired by the ultra-hip Seventies movie that goes by the same name.

A smooth, medium-bodied cigar with a creamy profile accompanied by notes of spice, earth, coffee, and a touch of sweetness. Its Honduran and Nicaraguan filler and Honduran binder is cloaked in a Connecticut Shade wrapper. To protect the wrapper, the cigar is dressed in an actual candela (green) tobacco leaf, which is to be removed prior to smoking. The Oscar Connecticut is the third release of the ever popular The Oscar series, which was first introduced in 2016. The cigars are expertly handmade at Oscar Valladares' own factory in Danli, Honduras.

A medium strength cigar with a warm creamy profile highlighted with earthy, spicy, and leathery notes and a pleasant floral finish. Made of 100% premium Nicaraguan tobacco from filler to wrapper. The Padilla Miami 8 & 11 is named after the location where the cigar is made, which is on 8th street and 11th avenue in Miami, Florida at the famed El Titan de Bronze factory. It is a re-creation of the original cigar, which was first release in 2005.

The Padron 1964 Anniversary Hermoso Natural is an integral part of the esteemed brands flagship 1964 Anniversary line, offering a perfect balance of superb quality and utmost value. This golden-hued Nicaraguan puro is simply exquisite, with a texture that is 100% exclusively Padron. Delivering a complex, medium-bodied profile containing notes of cedar, coffee, and roasted nuts, this short and stout robusto has a toasty cinnamon finish with an ideal pinch of white pepper. An extraordinary smoke that is absolutely mandatory for every humidor.

A medium strength cigar that exudes luxurious notes of almonds, cinnamon, nutmeg, and cedar. This Nicaraguan puro features a smooth natural wrapper that telegraphs its rich complexity. Handmade in Nicaragua, the Padron 50th Anniversary Natural cigar was crafted to commemorate the brand's five decades of crafting some of the finest cigars in the world.

These Premium Handmade long filler cigars are cured, aged and blended with vintage leaves of sun-grown tobacco. Their aroma, taste and consistency are guaranteed by the traditional Cuban Cigar making process that Padron sets as its standard.  This robusto was rated 88 by Cigar Aficionado in December of 2005.

Made in the Dominican Republic at the Augusto Reyes factory, the Patoro Churchill is a small-batch offering that uses Cuban-seed tobaccos from the Santiago Valley to provide a traditional yet ambitious blend. Composed of a golden Brazilian wrapper on top of a Dominican binder and premium Dominican fillers, this medium-bodied churchill is more than ready to impress palates everywhere with its smooth, creamy notes of cedar and nuts throughout a crisp, toasty finish.

Made in the Dominican Republic at the Augusto Reyes factory, the Patoro Corona is a small-batch offering that uses Cuban-seed tobaccos from the Santiago Valley to provide a traditional yet ambitious blend. Composed of a golden Brazilian wrapper on top of a Dominican binder and premium Dominican fillers, this medium-bodied corona is more than ready to impress palates everywhere with its smooth, creamy notes of cedar and nuts throughout a crisp, toasty finish.

The Patoro Cuvée Royale XXV opens with refined notes of cedar, cream, roasted nuts, and subtle spice, delivering an elegant and balanced profile that has become a signature of the brand. Natural tobacco sweetness and smooth Dominican character bring depth to the experience, creating a sophisticated smoke that rewards a slower pace.Created to celebrate Patoro's 25th anniversary, the Cuvée Royale XXV is a Dominican puro crafted with aged tobaccos and offered as a limited release. Produced in just 600 boxes worldwide, with only half allocated to the U.S. market, this special edition reflects the brand's dedication to premium Dominican tobacco and meticulous blending. For fans of Patoro's refined style, this release carries the same graceful complexity that makes the brand's most celebrated cigars stand out.

Made in the Dominican Republic at the Augusto Reyes factory, the Patoro Robusto is a small-batch offering that uses Cuban-seed tobaccos from the Santiago Valley to provide a traditional yet ambitious blend. Composed of a golden Brazilian wrapper on top of a Dominican binder and premium Dominican fillers, this medium-bodied robusto is more than ready to impress palates everywhere with its smooth, creamy notes of cedar and nuts throughout a crisp, toasty finish.

This smooth medium-bodied cigar has a creamy profile and offers notes of cedar and nuts and a crisp, toasty finish. Its Brazilian wrapper cloaks a Dominican binder and premium Dominican filler leaves. Handmade at the Augusto Reyes factory in the Dominican Republic, the Patoro Serie P cigar is a small-batch offering that uses Cuban-seed tobaccos from the Santiago Valley to provide a traditional smoking experience.

When a boutique brand owner steps away from the executive desk and back to the rolling table, you know the resulting blend is going to be something legendary. PDR El Vinyet is a small-batch, annual release born directly from the passion of PDR Cigars' founder and Master Blender, Abe Flores. To guarantee absolute perfection in airflow and construction, Flores personally hand-bunched the initial production run at the PDR Factory in Tamboril, Dominican Republic.El Vinyet is a multi-national blend built for smokers who appreciate nuance, depth, and unwavering complexity. The core features a robust filler combination of rich Dominican Habano and gritty USA Pennsylvania Broadleaf. Held tightly together by a savory Indonesian binder, the entire package is seamlessly dressed in a dark, lustrous Ecuadorian Habano Oscuro wrapper.This full-bodied, full-flavored smoke wastes no time making an impression. From the first light, your palate is treated to an elegant harmony of rich cedar, roasted almonds, and deep earth. As the traditional Entubado Cuban rolling method allows for a flawlessly smooth, cool draw, the blend evolves to reveal sophisticated notes of dark cocoa, fresh espresso, a zesty pop of black pepper, and a subtle caramelized sweetness on the finish.Presented in elegant 10-count boxes and dressed in premium gold foil sleeves, these limited-production sticks disappear quickly upon arrival.

With 10 year old tobaccos included in this precise blend, this rich robusto is set to deliver incomparable notes of cocoa, leather, and earth, with the perfect amount of spice to round out an overall creamy finish.

Rich cocoa, toasted oak, and warm baking spice lead the Plasencia Triunfal, a medium-to-full bodied smoke that builds with steady depth and a polished, layered complexity. It opens with a bold core of earth and spice, gradually unfolding into smoother notes of dark sweetness and nutty undertones.Triunfal is a special celebratory release from Plasencia Cigars, crafted in Nicaragua. This cigar is the brand's tribute to the 2026 FIFA World Cup. It also arrives alongside Plasencia's refreshed branding direction, which leans into a more modern, streamlined identity while still emphasizing the family's long-standing relationship to tobacco. The result is a commemorative release that aligns a global sporting moment with one of the most established names in premium cigars.

Back for another year, Plasencia delivers another gem! The brand's yearly homage to the Chinese zodiac, never disappoints and routinely sells out. I'd expect the same for this year's Year of the Snake. This year's blend comes in boxes of 10. There's eight lanceros and then there's a two cigar Culebra added into the mix as well. Both the lanceros and the Culebra weigh in at 7 x 40. The cigars are comprised of all Nicaraguan tobaccos that are grown at the Plasencia family farm. Expect a medium to full-bodied blend t with notes of spice, earth, and leather. Balanced and smooth, this is another Plasencia blend that won't disappoint!

Plasencia's newest Lunar New Year release stick is as imposing as it is eye-catching. Sizing up at 7 x 58, the Year of the Horse 2026 promises to be a smoke with a lot of horsepower under the hood. The blend features a beautiful Colorado wrapper from the Jalapa region of Nicaragua, a Nicaraguan binder, and two different fillers from Nicaragua and Honduras. Under the cap, each cigar comes with a beautifully braided tail, evoking the braided tail seen on many race horses. Plasencia states the profile is complex and rich, with surprising Asian flavors. They report Oak, cumin, cardamom, and dark chocolate as the main tasting notes. These cigars come in beautiful 10-count boxes, with an unmistakably Chinese motif, matching their previous Lunar New Year releases. Only 6,000 boxes were shipped, meaning the Plasencia Year of the Horse will undoubtedly be one of the most exclusive releases this holiday season.
